text: David said to Ahimelech, "Isn't there here under your hand spear or sword? For I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king's business required haste."

title: 1 Samuel 21:9
text: The priest said, "The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the valley of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you will take that, take it; for there is no other except that here." David said, "There is none like that. Give it to me."

title: 1 Samuel 21:10
text: David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.

title: 1 Samuel 21:11
text: The servants of Achish said to him, "Isn't this David the king of the land? Didn't they sing one to another about him in dances, saying, 'Saul has slain his thousands, David his ten thousands?'"

title: 1 Samuel 21:12
text: David laid up these words in his heart, and was very afraid of Achish the king of Gath.

title: 1 Samuel 21:13
text: He changed his behavior before them, and pretended to be mad in their hands, and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down on his beard.

title: 1 Samuel 21:14
text: Then Achish said to his servants, "Look, you see the man is mad. Why then have you brought him to me?

title: 1 Samuel 21:15
text: Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? Shall this fellow come into my house?"

title: 1 Samuel 22:1
text: David therefore departed there, and escaped to the cave of Adullam. When his brothers and all his father's house heard it, they went down there to him.

title: 1 Samuel 22:2
text: Everyone who was in distress, and everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was discontented, gathered themselves to him; and he became captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.

title: 1 Samuel 22:3
text: David went there to Mizpeh of Moab, and he said to the king of Moab, "Please let my father and my mother come out with you, until I know what God will do for me."

title: 1 Samuel 22:4
text: He brought them before the king of Moab; and they lived with him all the while that David was in the stronghold.

title: 1 Samuel 22:5
text: The prophet Gad said to David, "Don't stay in the stronghold. Depart, and go into the land of Judah." Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hereth.

title: 1 Samuel 22:6
text: Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men who were with him. Now Saul was sitting in Gibeah, under the tamarisk tree in Ramah, with his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him.

title: 1 Samuel 22:7
text: Saul said to his servants who stood about him, "Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give everyone of you fields and vineyards, will he make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds,

title: 1 Samuel 22:8
text: that all of you have conspired against me, and there is none who discloses to me when my son makes a treaty with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you who is sorry for me, or discloses to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?"

title: 1 Samuel 22:9
text: Then Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, answered and said, "I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

title: 1 Samuel 22:10
text: He inquired of Yahweh for him, gave him food, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine."

title: 1 Samuel 22:11
text: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father's house, the priests who were in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.

title: 1 Samuel 22:12
text: Saul said, "Hear now, you son of Ahitub." He answered, "Here I am, my lord."

title: 1 Samuel 22:13
text: Saul said to him, "Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread, and a sword, and have inquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?"

title: 1 Samuel 22:14
text: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, "Who among all your servants is so faithful as David, who is the king's son-in-law, and is taken into your council, and is honorable in your house?

title: 1 Samuel 22:15
text: Have I today begun to inquire of God for him? Be it far from me! Don't let the king impute anything to his servant, nor to all the house of my father; for your servant knows nothing of all this, less or more."

title: 1 Samuel 22:16
text: The king said, "You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you, and all your father's house."

title: 1 Samuel 22:17
text: The king said to the guard who stood about him, "Turn, and kill the priests of Yahweh; because their hand also is with David, and because they knew that he fled, and didn't disclose it to me." But the servants of the king wouldn't put forth their hand to fall on the priests of Yahweh.

title: 1 Samuel 22:18
text: The king said to Doeg, "Turn and attack the priests!" Doeg the Edomite turned, and he attacked the priests, and he killed on that day eighty-five people who wore a linen ephod.

title: 1 Samuel 22:19
text: He struck Nob, the city of the priests, with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and nursing babies, and cattle and donkeys and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

title: 1 Samuel 22:20
text: One of the sons of Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.

title: 1 Samuel 22:21
text: Abiathar told David that Saul had slain Yahweh's priests.

title: 1 Samuel 22:22
text: David said to Abiathar, "I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul. I am responsible for the death of all the persons of your father's house.

title: 1 Samuel 22:23
text: Stay with me, don't be afraid; for he who seeks my life seeks your life. For with me you shall be in safeguard."

title: 1 Samuel 23:1
text: David was told, "Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and are robbing the threshing floors."

title: 1 Samuel 23:2
text: Therefore David inquired of Yahweh, saying, "Shall I go and strike these Philistines?" Yahweh said to David, "Go strike the Philistines, and save Keilah."

title: 1 Samuel 23:3
text: David's men said to him, "Behold, we are afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?"

title: 1 Samuel 23:4
text: Then David inquired of Yahweh yet again. Yahweh answered him, and said, "Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into your hand."

title: 1 Samuel 23:5
text: David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their livestock, and killed them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

title: 1 Samuel 23:6
text: It happened, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.

title: 1 Samuel 23:7
text: It was told Saul that David had come to Keilah. Saul said, "God has delivered him into my hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that has gates and bars."

title: 1 Samuel 23:8
text: Saul summoned all the people to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.

title: 1 Samuel 23:9
text: David knew that Saul was devising mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, "Bring the ephod here."

title: 1 Samuel 23:10
text: Then David said, "O Yahweh, the God of Israel, your servant has surely heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.

title: 1 Samuel 23:11
text: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? Yahweh, the God of Israel, I beg you, tell your servant." Yahweh said, "He will come down."

title: 1 Samuel 23:12
text: Then David said, "Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul?" Yahweh said, "They will deliver you up."

title: 1 Samuel 23:13
text: Then David and his men, who were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah, and went wherever they could go. It was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah; and he gave up going there.

title: 1 Samuel 23:14
text: David stayed in the wilderness in the strongholds, and remained in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph. Saul sought him every day, but God didn't deliver him into his hand.

title: 1 Samuel 23:15
text: David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. David was in the wilderness of Ziph in the wood.

title: 1 Samuel 23:16
text: Jonathan, Saul's son, arose, and went to David into the woods, and strengthened his hand in God.

title: 1 Samuel 23:17
text: He said to him, "Don't be afraid; for the hand of Saul my father shall not find you; and you shall be king over Israel, and I shall be next to you; and that also Saul my father knows."

title: 1 Samuel 23:18
text: They both made a covenant before Yahweh: and David stayed in the woods, and Jonathan went to his house.

title: 1 Samuel 23:19
text: Then the Ziphites came up to Saul to Gibeah, saying, "Doesn't David hide himself with us in the strongholds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of the desert?

title: 1 Samuel 23:20
text: Now therefore, O king, come down, according to all the desire of your soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver him up into the king's hand."

title: 1 Samuel 23:21
text: Saul said, "You are blessed by Yahweh; for you have had compassion on me.

title: 1 Samuel 23:22
text: Please go make yet more sure, and know and see his place where his haunt is, [and] who has seen him there; for it is told me that he deals very subtly.

title: 1 Samuel 23:23
text: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself, and come again to me with certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall happen, if he is in the land, that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah."

title: 1 Samuel 23:24
text: They arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah on the south of the desert.

title: 1 Samuel 23:25
text: Saul and his men went to seek him. When David was told, he went down to the rock, and stayed in the wilderness of Maon. When Saul heard [that], he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.

title: 1 Samuel 23:26
text: Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men surrounded David and his men to take them.

title: 1 Samuel 23:27
text: But a messenger came to Saul, saying, "Hurry and come; for the Philistines have made a raid on the land!"

title: 1 Samuel 23:28
text: So Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Sela Hammahlekoth.

title: 1 Samuel 23:29
text: David went up from there, and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.

title: 1 Samuel 24:1
text: It happened, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, "Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi."

title: 1 Samuel 24:2
text: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild goats.

title: 1 Samuel 24:3
text: He came to the sheep pens by the way, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men were abiding in the innermost parts of the cave.

title: 1 Samuel 24:4
text: The men of David said to him, "Behold, the day of which Yahweh said to you, 'Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, and you shall do to him as it shall seem good to you.'" Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe secretly.

title: 1 Samuel 24:5
text: It happened afterward, that David's heart struck him, because he had cut off Saul's skirt.

title: 1 Samuel 24:6
text: He said to his men, "Yahweh forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, Yahweh's anointed, to put forth my hand against him, since he is Yahweh's anointed."

title: 1 Samuel 24:7
text: So David checked his men with these words, and didn't allow them to rise against Saul. Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

title: 1 Samuel 24:8
text: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, "My lord the king!" When Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and did obeisance.

title: 1 Samuel 24:9
text: David said to Saul, "Why do you listen to men's words, saying, 'Behold, David seeks your hurt?'

title: 1 Samuel 24:10
text: Behold, this day your eyes have seen how that Yahweh had delivered you today into my hand in the cave. Some urged me to kill you; but I spared you; and I said, I will not put forth my hand against my lord; for he is Yahweh's anointed.

title: 1 Samuel 24:11
text: Moreover, my father, behold, yes, see the skirt of your robe in my hand; for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe, and didn't kill you, know and see that there is neither evil nor disobedience in my hand, and I have not sinned against you, though you hunt for my life to take it.

title: 1 Samuel 24:12
text: May Yahweh judge between me and you, and may Yahweh avenge me of you; but my hand shall not be on you.

title: 1 Samuel 24:13
text: As the proverb of the ancients says, 'Out of the wicked comes forth wickedness;' but my hand shall not be on you.

title: 1 Samuel 24:14
text: Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom do you pursue? A dead dog? A flea?

title: 1 Samuel 24:15
text: May Yahweh therefore be judge, and give sentence between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of your hand."

title: 1 Samuel 24:16
text: It came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, "Is this your voice, my son David?" Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.

title: 1 Samuel 24:17
text: He said to David, "You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.

title: 1 Samuel 24:18
text: You have declared this day how you have dealt well with me, because when Yahweh had delivered me up into your hand, you didn't kill me.

title: 1 Samuel 24:19
text: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away unharmed? Therefore may Yahweh reward you good for that which you have done to me this day.

title: 1 Samuel 24:20
text: Now, behold, I know that you shall surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in your hand.

title: 1 Samuel 24:21
text: Swear now therefore to me by Yahweh, that you will not cut off my seed after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father's house."

title: 1 Samuel 24:22
text: David swore to Saul. Saul went home; but David and his men went up to the stronghold.

title: 1 Samuel 25:1
text: Samuel died; and all Israel gathered themselves together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

title: 1 Samuel 25:2
text: There was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

title: 1 Samuel 25:3
text: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail; and the woman was of good understanding, and of a beautiful face: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.

title: 1 Samuel 25:4
text: David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep.

title: 1 Samuel 25:5
text: David sent ten young men, and David said to the young men, "Go up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name.

title: 1 Samuel 25:6
text: You shall tell him, 'Long life to you! Peace be to you, and peace be to your house, and peace be to all that you have.

title: 1 Samuel 25:7
text: Now I have heard that you have shearers. Your shepherds have now been with us, and we did them no hurt, neither was there anything missing to them, all the while they were in Carmel.

title: 1 Samuel 25:8
text: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. Therefore, let the young men find favor in your eyes; for we come in a good day. Please give whatever comes to your hand, to your servants, and to your son David.'"

title: 1 Samuel 25:9
text: When David's young men came, they spoke to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.

title: 1 Samuel 25:10
text: Nabal answered David's servants, and said, "Who is David? Who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants who break away from their masters these days.

title: 1 Samuel 25:11
text: Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my meat that I have killed for my shearers, and give it to men who I don't know where they come from?"

title: 1 Samuel 25:12
text: So David's young men turned on their way, and went back, and came and told him according to all these words.

title: 1 Samuel 25:13
text: David said to his men, "Every man put on his sword!" Every man put on his sword. David also put on his sword. About four hundred men followed David; and two hundred stayed by the baggage.

title: 1 Samuel 25:14
text: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal's wife, saying, "Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to Greet our master; and he railed at them.

title: 1 Samuel 25:15
text: But the men were very good to us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we anything, as long as we went with them, when we were in the fields.

title: 1 Samuel 25:16
text: They were a wall to us both by night and by day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

title: 1 Samuel 25:17
text: Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his house; for he is such a worthless fellow that one can't speak to him."

title: 1 Samuel 25:18
text: Then Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread, two bottles of wine, five sheep ready dressed, five measures of parched grain, one hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on donkeys.

title: 1 Samuel 25:19
text: She said to her young men, "Go on before me. Behold, I come after you." But she didn't tell her husband, Nabal.

title: 1 Samuel 25:20
text: It was so, as she rode on her donkey, and came down by the covert of the mountain, that behold, David and his men came down toward her; and she met them.

title: 1 Samuel 25:21
text: Now David had said, "Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained to him. He has returned me evil for good.

title: 1 Samuel 25:22
text: God do so to the enemies of David, and more also, if I leave of all that belongs to him by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall."

title: 1 Samuel 25:23
text: When Abigail saw David, she hurried, and alighted from her donkey, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground.

title: 1 Samuel 25:24
text: She fell at his feet, and said, "On me, my lord, on me be the iniquity; and please let your handmaid speak in your ears. Hear the words of your handmaid.

title: 1 Samuel 25:25
text: Please don't let my lord regard this worthless fellow, even Nabal; for as his name is, so is he. Nabal is his name, and folly is with him; but I, your handmaid, didn't see the young men of my lord, whom you sent.

title: 1 Samuel 25:26
text: Now therefore, my lord, as Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, since Yahweh has withheld you from blood guiltiness, and from avenging yourself with your own hand, now therefore let your enemies, and those who seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.

title: 1 Samuel 25:27
text: Now this present which your servant has brought to my lord, let it be given to the young men who follow my lord.

title: 1 Samuel 25:28
text: Please forgive the trespass of your handmaid. For Yahweh will certainly make my lord a sure house, because my lord fights the battles of Yahweh; and evil shall not be found in you all your days.

title: 1 Samuel 25:29
text: Though men may rise up to pursue you, and to seek your soul, yet the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with Yahweh your God. He will sling out the souls of your enemies, as from the hollow of a sling.

title: 1 Samuel 25:30
text: It shall come to pass, when Yahweh has done to my lord according to all the good that he has spoken concerning you, and shall have appointed you prince over Israel,

title: 1 Samuel 25:31
text: that this shall be no grief to you, nor offense of heart to my lord, either that you have shed blood without cause, or that my lord has avenged himself. When Yahweh has dealt well with my lord, then remember your handmaid."

title: 1 Samuel 25:32
text: David said to Abigail, "Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who sent you this day to meet me!

title: 1 Samuel 25:33
text: Blessed is your discretion, and blessed are you, that have kept me this day from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself with my own hand.

title: 1 Samuel 25:34
text: For indeed, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, lives, who has withheld me from hurting you, unless you had hurried and come to meet me, surely there wouldn't have been left to Nabal by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall."

title: 1 Samuel 25:35
text: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him: and he said to her, "Go up in peace to your house. Behold, I have listened to your voice, and have granted your request."

title: 1 Samuel 25:36
text: Abigail came to Nabal; and behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king. Nabal's heart was merry within him, for he was very drunken. Therefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.

title: 1 Samuel 25:37
text: It happened in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, that his wife told him these things, and his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.

title: 1 Samuel 25:38
text: It happened about ten days after, that Yahweh struck Nabal, so that he died.

title: 1 Samuel 25:39
text: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, "Blessed is Yahweh, who has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and has kept back his servant from evil. Yahweh has returned the evildoing of Nabal on his own head." David sent and spoke concerning Abigail, to take her to him as wife.

title: 1 Samuel 25:40
text: When the servants of David had come to Abigail to Carmel, they spoke to her, saying, "David has sent us to you, to take you to him as wife."

title: 1 Samuel 25:41
text: She arose, and bowed herself with her face to the earth, and said, "Behold, your handmaid is a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord."

title: 1 Samuel 25:42
text: Abigail hurried, and arose, and rode on a donkey, with five ladies of hers who followed her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

title: 1 Samuel 25:43
text: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they both became his wives.

title: 1 Samuel 25:44
text: Now Saul had given Michal his daughter, David's wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was of Gallim.

title: 1 Samuel 26:1
text: The Ziphites came to Saul to Gibeah, saying, "Doesn't David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert?"

title: 1 Samuel 26:2
text: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.

title: 1 Samuel 26:3
text: Saul encamped in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert, by the way. But David stayed in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

title: 1 Samuel 26:4
text: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul had certainly come.

title: 1 Samuel 26:5
text: David arose, and came to the place where Saul had encamped; and David saw the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his army: and Saul lay within the place of the wagons, and the people were encamped around him.

title: 1 Samuel 26:6
text: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, saying, "Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp?" Abishai said, "I will go down with you."

title: 1 Samuel 26:7
text: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the place of the wagons, with his spear stuck in the ground at his head; and Abner and the people lay around him.

title: 1 Samuel 26:8
text: Then Abishai said to David, "God has delivered up your enemy into your hand this day. Now therefore please let me strike him with the spear to the earth at one stroke, and I will not strike him the second time."

title: 1 Samuel 26:9
text: David said to Abishai, "Don't destroy him; for who can put forth his hand against Yahweh's anointed, and be guiltless?"

title: 1 Samuel 26:10
text: David said, "As Yahweh lives, Yahweh will strike him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall go down into battle and perish.

title: 1 Samuel 26:11
text: Yahweh forbid that I should put forth my hand against Yahweh's anointed; but now please take the spear that is at his head, and the jar of water, and let us go."

title: 1 Samuel 26:12
text: So David took the spear and the jar of water from Saul's head; and they went away: and no man saw it, nor knew it, neither did any awake; for they were all asleep, because a deep sleep from Yahweh was fallen on them.

title: 1 Samuel 26:13
text: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of the mountain afar off; a great space being between them;

title: 1 Samuel 26:14
text: and David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, "Don't you answer, Abner?" Then Abner answered, "Who are you who cries to the king?"

title: 1 Samuel 26:15
text: David said to Abner, "Aren't you a man? Who is like you in Israel? Why then have you not kept watch over your lord, the king? For one of the people came in to destroy the king your lord.

title: 1 Samuel 26:16
text: This thing isn't good that you have done. As Yahweh lives, you are worthy to die, because you have not kept watch over your lord, Yahweh's anointed. Now see where the king's spear is, and the jar of water that was at his head."

title: 1 Samuel 26:17
text: Saul knew David's voice, and said, "Is this your voice, my son David?" David said, "It is my voice, my lord, O king."

title: 1 Samuel 26:18
text: He said, "Why does my lord pursue after his servant? For what have I done? Or what evil is in my hand?

title: 1 Samuel 26:19
text: Now therefore, please let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If it is so that Yahweh has stirred you up against me, let him accept an offering. But if it is the children of men, they are cursed before Yahweh; for they have driven me out this day that I shouldn't cling to Yahweh's inheritance, saying, 'Go, serve other gods!'

title: 1 Samuel 26:20
text: Now therefore, don't let my blood fall to the earth away from the presence of Yahweh; for the king of Israel has come out to seek a flea, as when one hunts a partridge in the mountains."

title: 1 Samuel 26:21
text: Then Saul said, "I have sinned. Return, my son David; for I will no more do you harm, because my life was precious in your eyes this day. Behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly."

title: 1 Samuel 26:22
text: David answered, "Behold the spear, O king! Then let one of the young men come over and get it.

title: 1 Samuel 26:23
text: Yahweh will render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; because Yahweh delivered you into my hand today, and I wouldn't put forth my hand against Yahweh's anointed.

title: 1 Samuel 26:24
text: Behold, as your life was respected this day in my eyes, so let my life be respected in the eyes of Yahweh, and let him deliver me out of all oppression."

title: 1 Samuel 26:25
text: Then Saul said to David, "You are blessed, my son David. You shall both do mightily, and shall surely prevail." So David went his way, and Saul returned to his place.

title: 1 Samuel 27:1
text: David said in his heart, "I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than that I should escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul will despair of me, to seek me any more in all the borders of Israel. So shall I escape out of his hand."

title: 1 Samuel 27:2
text: David arose, and passed over, he and the six hundred men who were with him, to Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

title: 1 Samuel 27:3
text: David lived with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal's wife.

title: 1 Samuel 27:4
text: It was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.

title: 1 Samuel 27:5
text: David said to Achish, "If now I have found favor in your eyes, let them give me a place in one of the cities in the country, that I may dwell there. For why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you?"

title: 1 Samuel 27:6
text: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: why Ziklag pertains to the kings of Judah to this day.

title: 1 Samuel 27:7
text: The number of the days that David lived in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.

title: 1 Samuel 27:8
text: David and his men went up, and made a raid on the Geshurites, and the Girzites, and the Amalekites; for those [nations] were the inhabitants of the land, who were of old, as you go to Shur, even to the land of Egypt.

title: 1 Samuel 27:9
text: David struck the land, and saved neither man nor woman alive, and took away the sheep, and the cattle, and the donkeys, and the camels, and the clothing; and he returned, and came to Achish.

title: 1 Samuel 27:10
text: Achish said, "Against whom have you made a raid today?" David said, "Against the South of Judah, against the South of the Jerahmeelites, and against the South of the Kenites."

title: 1 Samuel 27:11
text: David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring them to Gath, saying, "Lest they should tell of us, saying, 'So did David, and so has been his way all the while he has lived in the country of the Philistines.'"

title: 1 Samuel 27:12
text: Achish believed David, saying, "He has made his people Israel utterly to abhor him. Therefore he shall be my servant forever."

title: 1 Samuel 28:1
text: It happened in those days, that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. Achish said to David, "Know assuredly that you shall go out with me in the army, you and your men."

title: 1 Samuel 28:2
text: David said to Achish, "Therefore you shall know what your servant will do." Achish said to David, "Therefore will I make you my bodyguard for ever."

title: 1 Samuel 28:3
text: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had lamented him, and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. Saul had put away those who had familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.

title: 1 Samuel 28:4
text: The Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and encamped in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped in Gilboa.

title: 1 Samuel 28:5
text: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly.

title: 1 Samuel 28:6
text: When Saul inquired of Yahweh, Yahweh didn't answer him, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.

title: 1 Samuel 28:7
text: Then Saul said to his servants, "Seek me a woman who has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and inquire of her." His servants said to him, "Behold, there is a woman who has a familiar spirit at Endor."

title: 1 Samuel 28:8
text: Saul disguised himself, and put on other clothing, and went, he and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night: and he said, "Please divine to me by the familiar spirit, and bring me up whoever I shall name to you."

title: 1 Samuel 28:9
text: The woman said to him, "Behold, you know what Saul has done, how he has cut off those who have familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land. Why then do you lay a snare for my life, to cause me to die?"

title: 1 Samuel 28:10
text: Saul swore to her by Yahweh, saying, "As Yahweh lives, no punishment shall happen to you for this thing."

title: 1 Samuel 28:11
text: Then the woman said, "Whom shall I bring up to you?" He said, "Bring Samuel up for me."

title: 1 Samuel 28:12
text: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice; and the woman spoke to Saul, saying, "Why have you deceived me? For you are Saul!"

title: 1 Samuel 28:13
text: The king said to her, "Don't be afraid. For what do you see?" The woman said to Saul, "I see a god coming up out of the earth."

title: 1 Samuel 28:14
text: He said to her, "What does he look like?" She said, "An old man comes up. He is covered with a robe." Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he bowed with his face to the ground, and did obeisance.

title: 1 Samuel 28:15
text: Samuel said to Saul, "Why have you disturbed me, to bring me up?" Saul answered, "I am very distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God has departed from me, and answers me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams. Therefore I have called you, that you may make known to me what I shall do."

title: 1 Samuel 28:16
text: Samuel said, "Why then do you ask of me, since Yahweh has departed from you and has become your adversary?

title: 1 Samuel 28:17
text: Yahweh has done to you as he spoke by me. Yahweh has torn the kingdom out of your hand, and given it to your neighbor, even to David.

title: 1 Samuel 28:18
text: Because you didn't obey the voice of Yahweh, and didn't execute his fierce wrath on Amalek, therefore Yahweh has done this thing to you this day.

title: 1 Samuel 28:19
text: Moreover Yahweh will deliver Israel also with you into the hand of the Philistines; and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. Yahweh will deliver the army of Israel also into the hand of the Philistines."

title: 1 Samuel 28:20
text: Then Saul fell immediately his full length on the earth, and was terrified, because of the words of Samuel. There was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.

title: 1 Samuel 28:21
text: The woman came to Saul, and saw that he was very troubled, and said to him, "Behold, your handmaid has listened to your voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have listened to your words which you spoke to me.

title: 1 Samuel 28:22
text: Now therefore, please listen also to the voice of your handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before you; and eat, that you may have strength, when you go on your way."

title: 1 Samuel 28:23
text: But he refused, and said, I will not eat. But his servants, together with the woman, constrained him; and he listened to their voice. So he arose from the earth, and sat on the bed.

title: 1 Samuel 28:24
text: The woman had a fattened calf in the house. She hurried and killed it; and she took flour, and kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread of it.

title: 1 Samuel 28:25
text: She brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they ate. Then they rose up, and went away that night.

title: 1 Samuel 29:1
text: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek: and the Israelites encamped by the spring which is in Jezreel.

title: 1 Samuel 29:2
text: The lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by thousands; and David and his men passed on in the rear with Achish.

title: 1 Samuel 29:3
text: Then the princes of the Philistines said, "What about these Hebrews?" Achish said to the princes of the Philistines, "Isn't this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, who has been with me these days, or rather these years, and I have found no fault in him since he fell away to this day?"

title: 1 Samuel 29:4
text: But the princes of the Philistines were angry with him; and the princes of the Philistines said to him, "Make the man return, that he may go back to his place where you have appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he become an adversary to us. For with what should this fellow reconcile himself to his lord? Should it not be with the heads of these men?

title: 1 Samuel 29:5
text: Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, 'Saul has slain his thousands, David his ten thousands?'"

title: 1 Samuel 29:6
text: Then Achish called David, and said to him, "As Yahweh lives, you have been upright, and your going out and your coming in with me in the army is good in my sight; for I have not found evil in you since the day of your coming to me to this day. Nevertheless, the lords don't favor you.

title: 1 Samuel 29:7
text: Therefore now return, and go in peace, that you not displease the lords of the Philistines."

title: 1 Samuel 29:8
text: David said to Achish, "But what have I done? What have you found in your servant so long as I have been before you to this day, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?"

title: 1 Samuel 29:9
text: Achish answered David, "I know that you are good in my sight, as an angel of God. Notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, 'He shall not go up with us to the battle.'

title: 1 Samuel 29:10
text: Therefore now rise up early in the morning with the servants of your lord who have come with you; and as soon as you are up early in the morning, and have light, depart."

title: 1 Samuel 29:11
text: So David rose up early, he and his men, to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. The Philistines went up to Jezreel.

title: 1 Samuel 30:1
text: It happened, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had made a raid on the South, and on Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag, and burned it with fire,

title: 1 Samuel 30:2
text: and had taken captive the women and all who were therein, both small and great. They didn't kill any, but carried them off, and went their way.

title: 1 Samuel 30:3
text: When David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were taken captive.

title: 1 Samuel 30:4
text: Then David and the people who were with him lifted up their voice and wept, until they had no more power to weep.

title: 1 Samuel 30:5
text: David's two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

title: 1 Samuel 30:6
text: David was greatly distressed; for the people spoke of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David strengthened himself in Yahweh his God.

title: 1 Samuel 30:7
text: David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, "Please bring me here the ephod." Abiathar brought the ephod to David.

title: 1 Samuel 30:8
text: David inquired of Yahweh, saying, "If I pursue after this troop, shall I overtake them?" He answered him, "Pursue; for you shall surely overtake them, and shall without fail recover all."

title: 1 Samuel 30:9
text: So David went, he and the six hundred men who were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those who were left behind stayed.

title: 1 Samuel 30:10
text: But David pursued, he and four hundred men; for two hundred stayed behind, who were so faint that they couldn't go over the brook Besor.

title: 1 Samuel 30:11
text: They found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he ate; and they gave him water to drink.

title: 1 Samuel 30:12
text: They gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins. when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him; for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.

title: 1 Samuel 30:13
text: David asked him, "To whom do you belong? Where are you from?" He said, "I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days ago I fell sick.

title: 1 Samuel 30:14
text: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire."

title: 1 Samuel 30:15
text: David said to him, "Will you bring me down to this troop?" He said, "Swear to me by God that you will neither kill me, nor deliver me up into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to this troop."

title: 1 Samuel 30:16
text: When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread around over all the ground, eating, drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.

title: 1 Samuel 30:17
text: David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped from there, except four hundred young men, who rode on camels and fled.

title: 1 Samuel 30:18
text: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken; and David rescued his two wives.

title: 1 Samuel 30:19
text: There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor anything that they had taken to them. David brought back all.

title: 1 Samuel 30:20
text: David took all the flocks and the herds, [which] they drove before those [other] livestock, and said, "This is David's spoil."

title: 1 Samuel 30:21
text: David came to the two hundred men, who were so faint that they could not follow David, whom also they had made to stay at the brook Besor; and they went forth to meet David, and to meet the people who were with him. When David came near to the people, he greeted them.

title: 1 Samuel 30:22
text: Then all the wicked men and base fellows, of those who went with David, answered and said, "Because they didn't go with us, we will not give them anything of the spoil that we have recovered, except to every man his wife and his children, that he may lead them away, and depart."

title: 1 Samuel 30:23
text: Then David said, "You shall not do so, my brothers, with that which Yahweh has given to us, who has preserved us, and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand.

title: 1 Samuel 30:24
text: Who will listen to you in this matter? For as his share is who goes down to the battle, so shall his share be who tarries by the baggage: they shall share alike."

title: 1 Samuel 30:25
text: It was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.

title: 1 Samuel 30:26
text: When David came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoil to the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, "Behold, a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of Yahweh."

title: 1 Samuel 30:27
text: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, and to those who were in Ramoth of the South, and to those who were in Jattir,

title: 1 Samuel 30:28
text: and to those who were in Aroer, and to those who were in Siphmoth, and to those who were in Eshtemoa,

title: 1 Samuel 30:29
text: and to those who were in Racal, and to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to those who were in the cities of the Kenites,

title: 1 Samuel 30:30
text: and to those who were in Hormah, and to those who were in Borashan, and to those who were in Athach,

title: 1 Samuel 30:31
text: and to those who were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men used to stay.

title: 1 Samuel 31:1
text: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

title: 1 Samuel 31:2
text: The Philistines followed hard on Saul and on his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

title: 1 Samuel 31:3
text: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was greatly distressed by reason of the archers.

title: 1 Samuel 31:4
text: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, "Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and abuse me!" But his armor bearer would not; for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword, and fell on it.

title: 1 Samuel 31:5
text: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died with him.

title: 1 Samuel 31:6
text: So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armor bearer, and all his men, that same day together.

title: 1 Samuel 31:7
text: When the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, and those who were beyond the Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

title: 1 Samuel 31:8
text: It happened on the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

title: 1 Samuel 31:9
text: They cut off his head, and stripped off his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to carry the news to the house of their idols, and to the people.

title: 1 Samuel 31:10
text: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth; and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.

title: 1 Samuel 31:11
text: When the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard concerning him that which the Philistines had done to Saul,

title: 1 Samuel 31:12
text: all the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth Shan; and they came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.

title: 1 Samuel 31:13
text: They took their bones, and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

title: 2 Samuel 1:1
text: It happened after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had stayed two days in Ziklag;

title: 2 Samuel 1:2
text: it happened on the third day, that behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul, with his clothes torn, and earth on his head: and so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.

title: 2 Samuel 1:3
text: David said to him, "Where do you come from?" He said to him, "I have escaped out of the camp of Israel."

title: 2 Samuel 1:4
text: David said to him, "How did it go? Please tell me." He answered, "The people have fled from the battle, and many of the people also have fallen and are dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also."

title: 2 Samuel 1:5
text: David said to the young man who told him, "How do you know that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead?"

title: 2 Samuel 1:6
text: The young man who told him said, "As I happened by chance on Mount Gilboa, behold, Saul was leaning on his spear; and behold, the chariots and the horsemen followed hard after him.

title: 2 Samuel 1:7
text: When he looked behind him, he saw me, and called to me. I answered, 'Here I am.'

title: 2 Samuel 1:8
text: He said to me, 'Who are you?' I answered him, 'I am an Amalekite.'

title: 2 Samuel 1:9
text: He said to me, 'Please stand beside me, and kill me; for anguish has taken hold of me, because my life is yet whole in me.'

title: 2 Samuel 1:10
text: So I stood beside him, and killed him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he had fallen. I took the crown that was on his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them here to my lord."

title: 2 Samuel 1:11
text: Then David took hold on his clothes, and tore them; and likewise all the men who were with him.

title: 2 Samuel 1:12
text: They mourned, and wept, and fasted until evening, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Yahweh, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.

title: 2 Samuel 1:13
text: David said to the young man who told him, "Where are you from?" He answered, "I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite."

title: 2 Samuel 1:14
text: David said to him, "How were you not afraid to put forth your hand to destroy Yahweh's anointed?"

title: 2 Samuel 1:15
text: David called one of the young men, and said, "Go near, and fall on him." He struck him, so that he died.

title: 2 Samuel 1:16
text: David said to him, "Your blood be on your head; for your mouth has testified against you, saying, 'I have slain Yahweh's anointed.'"

title: 2 Samuel 1:17
text: David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son

title: 2 Samuel 1:18
text: (and he commanded them to teach the children of Judah [the song of] the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jashar):

title: 2 Samuel 1:19
text: "Your glory, Israel, is slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!

title: 2 Samuel 1:20
text: Don't tell it in Gath. Don't publish it in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

title: 2 Samuel 1:21
text: You mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew nor rain on you, neither fields of offerings; For there the shield of the mighty was vilely cast away, The shield of Saul was not anointed with oil.

title: 2 Samuel 1:22
text: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, Jonathan's bow didn't turn back. Saul's sword didn't return empty.

title: 2 Samuel 1:23
text: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives. In their death, they were not divided. They were swifter than eagles. They were stronger than lions.

title: 2 Samuel 1:24
text: You daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet delicately, who put ornaments of gold on your clothing.

title: 2 Samuel 1:25
text: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! Jonathan is slain on your high places.

title: 2 Samuel 1:26
text: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan. You have been very pleasant to me. Your love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.

title: 2 Samuel 1:27
text: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!"

title: 2 Samuel 2:1
text: It happened after this, that David inquired of Yahweh, saying, "Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah?" Yahweh said to him, "Go up." David said, "Where shall I go up?" He said, "To Hebron."

title: 2 Samuel 2:2
text: So David went up there, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

title: 2 Samuel 2:3
text: David brought up his men who were with him, every man with his household. They lived in the cities of Hebron.

title: 2 Samuel 2:4
text: The men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. They told David, saying, "The men of Jabesh Gilead were those who buried Saul."

title: 2 Samuel 2:5
text: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead, and said to them, "Blessed are you by Yahweh, that you have shown this kindness to your lord, even to Saul, and have buried him.

title: 2 Samuel 2:6
text: Now may Yahweh show loving kindness and truth to you. I also will reward you for this kindness, because you have done this thing.

title: 2 Samuel 2:7
text: Now therefore let your hands be strong, and be valiant; for Saul your lord is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them."

title: 2 Samuel 2:8
text: Now Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul's army, had taken Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;

title: 2 Samuel 2:9
text: and he made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

title: 2 Samuel 2:10
text: Ishbosheth, Saul's son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

title: 2 Samuel 2:11
text: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

title: 2 Samuel 2:12
text: Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

title: 2 Samuel 2:13
text: Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.

title: 2 Samuel 2:14
text: Abner said to Joab, "Please let the young men arise and play before us!" Joab said, "Let them arise!"

title: 2 Samuel 2:15
text: Then they arose and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin, and for Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.

title: 2 Samuel 2:16
text: They caught everyone his fellow by the head, and [thrust] his sword in his fellow's side; so they fell down together: therefore that place was called Helkath Hazzurim, which is in Gibeon.

title: 2 Samuel 2:17
text: The battle was very severe that day: and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.

title: 2 Samuel 2:18
text: The three sons of Zeruiah were there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.

title: 2 Samuel 2:19
text: Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he didn't turn to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.

title: 2 Samuel 2:20
text: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, "Is it you, Asahel?" He answered, "It is I."

title: 2 Samuel 2:21
text: Abner said to him, "Turn aside to your right hand or to your left, and grab one of the young men, and take his armor." But Asahel would not turn aside from following him.

title: 2 Samuel 2:22
text: Abner said again to Asahel, "Turn aside from following me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How then should I hold up my face to Joab your brother?"

title: 2 Samuel 2:23
text: However he refused to turn aside. Therefore Abner with the back end of the spear struck him in the body, so that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place. It happened, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

title: 2 Samuel 2:24
text: But Joab and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

title: 2 Samuel 2:25
text: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one band, and stood on the top of a hill.

title: 2 Samuel 2:26
text: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, "Shall the sword devour forever? Don't you know that it will be bitterness in the latter end? How long shall it be then, before you ask the people to return from following their brothers?"

title: 2 Samuel 2:27
text: Joab said, "As God lives, if you had not spoken, surely then in the morning the people would have gone away, and not each followed his brother."

title: 2 Samuel 2:28
text: So Joab blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.

title: 2 Samuel 2:29
text: Abner and his men went all that night through the Arabah; and they passed over the Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and came to Mahanaim.

title: 2 Samuel 2:30
text: Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David's servants nineteen men and Asahel.

title: 2 Samuel 2:31
text: But the servants of David had struck of Benjamin, and of Abner's men, [so that] three hundred sixty men died.

title: 2 Samuel 2:32
text: They took up Asahel, and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was in Bethlehem. Joab and his men went all night, and the day broke on them at Hebron.

title: 2 Samuel 3:1
text: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: and David grew stronger and stronger, but the house of Saul grew weaker and weaker.

title: 2 Samuel 3:2
text: To David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

title: 2 Samuel 3:3
text: and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

title: 2 Samuel 3:4
text: and the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

title: 2 Samuel 3:5
text: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David's wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

title: 2 Samuel 3:6
text: It happened, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong in the house of Saul.

title: 2 Samuel 3:7
text: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and [Ishbosheth] said to Abner, "Why have you gone in to my father's concubine?"

title: 2 Samuel 3:8
text: Then was Abner very angry for the words of Ishbosheth, and said, "Am I a dog's head that belongs to Judah? Today I show kindness to the house of Saul your father, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David; and yet you charge me this day with a fault concerning this woman!

title: 2 Samuel 3:9
text: God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as Yahweh has sworn to David, I don't do even so to him;

title: 2 Samuel 3:10
text: to transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba."

title: 2 Samuel 3:11
text: He could not answer Abner another word, because he feared him.

title: 2 Samuel 3:12
text: Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, "Whose is the land?" and saying, "Make your alliance with me, and behold, my hand shall be with you, to bring all Israel around to you."

title: 2 Samuel 3:13
text: He said, "Good; I will make a treaty with you; but one thing I require of you. That is, you shall not see my face, unless you first bring Michal, Saul's daughter, when you come to see my face."

title: 2 Samuel 3:14
text: David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul's son, saying, "Deliver me my wife Michal, whom I pledged to be married to me for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines."

title: 2 Samuel 3:15
text: Ishbosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Paltiel the son of Laish.

title: 2 Samuel 3:16
text: Her husband went with her, weeping as he went, and followed her to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, "Go! Return!" and he returned.

title: 2 Samuel 3:17
text: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, "In times past, you sought for David to be king over you.

title: 2 Samuel 3:18
text: Now then do it; for Yahweh has spoken of David, saying, 'By the hand of my servant David, I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.'"

title: 2 Samuel 3:19
text: Abner also spoke in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and to the whole house of Benjamin.

title: 2 Samuel 3:20
text: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. David made Abner and the men who were with him a feast.

title: 2 Samuel 3:21
text: Abner said to David, "I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your soul desires." David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

title: 2 Samuel 3:22
text: Behold, the servants of David and Joab came from a foray, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.

title: 2 Samuel 3:23
text: When Joab and all the army who was with him had come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has sent him away, and he is gone in peace.

title: 2 Samuel 3:24
text: Then Joab came to the king, and said, "What have you done? Behold, Abner came to you. Why is it that you have sent him away, and he is quite gone?

title: 2 Samuel 3:25
text: You know Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you do."

title: 2 Samuel 3:26
text: When Joab had come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah; but David didn't know it.

title: 2 Samuel 3:27
text: When Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the midst of the gate to speak with him quietly, and struck him there in the body, so that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.

title: 2 Samuel 3:28
text: Afterward, when David heard it, he said, "I and my kingdom are guiltless before Yahweh forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.

title: 2 Samuel 3:29
text: Let it fall on the head of Joab, and on all his father's house. Let there not fail from the house of Joab one who has an issue, or who is a leper, or who leans on a staff, or who falls by the sword, or who lacks bread."

title: 2 Samuel 3:30
text: So Joab and Abishai his brother killed Abner, because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

title: 2 Samuel 3:31
text: David said to Joab, and to all the people who were with him, Tear your clothes, and clothe yourselves with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. King David followed the bier.

title: 2 Samuel 3:32
text: They buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.

title: 2 Samuel 3:33
text: The king lamented for Abner, and said, "Should Abner die as a fool dies?

title: 2 Samuel 3:34
text: Your hands were not bound, nor your feet put into fetters. As a man falls before the children of iniquity, so you fell." All the people wept again over him.

title: 2 Samuel 3:35
text: All the people came to cause David to eat bread while it was yet day; but David swore, saying, "God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or anything else, until the sun goes down."

title: 2 Samuel 3:36
text: All the people took notice of it, and it pleased them; as whatever the king did pleased all the people.

title: 2 Samuel 3:37
text: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill Abner the son of Ner.

title: 2 Samuel 3:38
text: The king said to his servants, "Don't you know that there a prince and a great man has fallen this day in Israel?

title: 2 Samuel 3:39
text: I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May Yahweh reward the evildoer according to his wickedness."

title: 2 Samuel 4:1
text: When [Ishbosheth], Saul's son, heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands became feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

title: 2 Samuel 4:2
text: [Ishbosheth], Saul's son, [had] two men who were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin (for Beeroth also is reckoned to Benjamin:

title: 2 Samuel 4:3
text: and the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and have lived as foreigners there until this day).

title: 2 Samuel 4:4
text: Now Jonathan, Saul's son, had a son who was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the news came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel; and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it happened, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. His name was Mephibosheth.

title: 2 Samuel 4:5
text: The sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth, as he took his rest at noon.

title: 2 Samuel 4:6
text: They came there into the midst of the house, as though they would have fetched wheat; and they struck him in the body: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

title: 2 Samuel 4:7
text: Now when they came into the house, as he lay on his bed in his bedroom, they struck him, and killed him, and beheaded him, and took his head, and went by the way of the Arabah all night.

title: 2 Samuel 4:8
text: They brought the head of Ishbosheth to David to Hebron, and said to the king, "Behold, the head of Ishbosheth, the son of Saul, your enemy, who sought your life! Yahweh has avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed."

title: 2 Samuel 4:9
text: David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, "As Yahweh lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

title: 2 Samuel 4:10
text: when someone told me, 'Behold, Saul is dead,' thinking to have brought good news, I took hold of him, and killed him in Ziklag, which was the reward I gave him for his news.

title: 2 Samuel 4:11
text: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house on his bed, shall I not now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?"

title: 2 Samuel 4:12
text: David commanded his young men, and they killed them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up beside the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth, and buried it in the grave of Abner in Hebron.

title: 2 Samuel 5:1
text: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David to Hebron, and spoke, saying, "Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

title: 2 Samuel 5:2
text: In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. Yahweh said to you, 'You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over Israel.'"

title: 2 Samuel 5:3
text: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh; and they anointed David king over Israel.

title: 2 Samuel 5:4
text: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

title: 2 Samuel 5:5
text: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months; and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.

title: 2 Samuel 5:6
text: The king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spoke to David, saying, "Unless you take away the blind and the lame, you shall not come in here;" thinking, "David can't come in here."

title: 2 Samuel 5:7
text: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion; the same is the city of David.

title: 2 Samuel 5:8
text: David said on that day, "Whoever strikes the Jebusites, let him get up to the watercourse, and strike the lame and the blind, who are hated by David's soul." Therefore they say, "The blind and the lame can't come into the house."

title: 2 Samuel 5:9
text: David lived in the stronghold, and called it the city of David. David built around from Millo and inward.

title: 2 Samuel 5:10
text: David grew greater and greater; for Yahweh, the God of Armies, was with him.

title: 2 Samuel 5:11
text: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons; and they built David a house.

title: 2 Samuel 5:12
text: David perceived that Yahweh had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel's sake.

title: 2 Samuel 5:13
text: David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron; and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.

title: 2 Samuel 5:14
text: These are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,

title: 2 Samuel 5:15
text: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

title: 2 Samuel 5:16
text: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet.

title: 2 Samuel 5:17
text: When the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went down to the stronghold.

title: 2 Samuel 5:18
text: Now the Philistines had come and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

title: 2 Samuel 5:19
text: David inquired of Yahweh, saying, "Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?" Yahweh said to David, "Go up; for I will certainly deliver the Philistines into your hand."

title: 2 Samuel 5:20
text: David came to Baal Perazim, and David struck them there; and he said, "Yahweh has broken my enemies before me, like the breach of waters." Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

title: 2 Samuel 5:21
text: They left their images there; and David and his men took them away.

title: 2 Samuel 5:22
text: The Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

title: 2 Samuel 5:23
text: When David inquired of Yahweh, he said, "You shall not go up. Circle around behind them, and attack them over against the mulberry trees.

title: 2 Samuel 5:24
text: It shall be, when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then you shall stir yourself up; for then Yahweh has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines."

title: 2 Samuel 5:25
text: David did so, as Yahweh commanded him, and struck the Philistines from Geba until you come to Gezer.

title: 2 Samuel 6:1
text: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

title: 2 Samuel 6:2
text: David arose, and went with all the people who were with him, from Baale Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God, which is called by the Name, even the name of Yahweh of Armies who sits [above] the cherubim.

title: 2 Samuel 6:3
text: They set the ark of God on a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in the hill: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.

title: 2 Samuel 6:4
text: They brought it out of the house of Abinadab, which was in the hill, with the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark.

title: 2 Samuel 6:5
text: David and all the house of Israel played before Yahweh with all kinds of [instruments made of] fir wood, and with harps, and with stringed instruments, and with tambourines, and with castanets, and with cymbals.

title: 2 Samuel 6:6
text: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah put forth [his hand] to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the cattle stumbled.

title: 2 Samuel 6:7
text: The anger of Yahweh was kindled against Uzzah; and God struck him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.

title: 2 Samuel 6:8
text: David was displeased, because Yahweh had broken forth on Uzzah; and he called that place Perez Uzzah, to this day.

title: 2 Samuel 6:9
text: David was afraid of Yahweh that day; and he said, "How shall the ark of Yahweh come to me?"

title: 2 Samuel 6:10
text: So David would not move the ark of Yahweh to be with him in the city of David; but David carried it aside into the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.

title: 2 Samuel 6:11
text: The ark of Yahweh remained in the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite three months: and Yahweh blessed Obed-Edom, and all his house.

title: 2 Samuel 6:12
text: It was told king David, saying, "Yahweh has blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that pertains to him, because of the ark of God." David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed-Edom into the city of David with joy.

title: 2 Samuel 6:13
text: It was so, that, when those who bore the ark of Yahweh had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.

title: 2 Samuel 6:14
text: David danced before Yahweh with all his might; and David was clothed in a linen ephod.

title: 2 Samuel 6:15
text: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of Yahweh with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.

title: 2 Samuel 6:16
text: It was so, as the ark of Yahweh came into the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before Yahweh; and she despised him in her heart.

title: 2 Samuel 6:17
text: They brought in the ark of Yahweh, and set it in its place, in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahweh.

title: 2 Samuel 6:18
text: When David had made an end of offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Yahweh of Armies.

title: 2 Samuel 6:19
text: He dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to everyone a cake of bread, and a portion [of flesh], and a cake of raisins. So all the people departed everyone to his house.

title: 2 Samuel 6:20
text: Then David returned to bless his household. Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, "How glorious the king of Israel was today, who uncovered himself today in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!"

title: 2 Samuel 6:21
text: David said to Michal, "It was before Yahweh, who chose me above your father, and above all his house, to appoint me prince over the people of Yahweh, over Israel. Therefore will I celebrate before Yahweh.

title: 2 Samuel 6:22
text: I will be yet more vile than this, and will be base in my own sight. But of the handmaids of whom you have spoken, they shall honor me."

title: 2 Samuel 6:23
text: Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.

title: 2 Samuel 7:1
text: It happened, when the king lived in his house, and Yahweh had given him rest from all his enemies all around,

title: 2 Samuel 7:2
text: that the king said to Nathan the prophet, "See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of God dwells within curtains."

title: 2 Samuel 7:3
text: Nathan said to the king, "Go, do all that is in your heart; for Yahweh is with you."

title: 2 Samuel 7:4
text: It happened the same night, that the word of Yahweh came to Nathan, saying,

title: 2 Samuel 7:5
text: "Go and tell my servant David, 'Thus says Yahweh, "Shall you build me a house for me to dwell in?

title: 2 Samuel 7:6
text: For I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have moved around in a tent and in a tabernacle.

title: 2 Samuel 7:7
text: In all places in which I have walked with all the children of Israel, did I say a word to any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people Israel, saying, 'Why have you not built me a house of cedar?'"'

title: 2 Samuel 7:8
text: Now therefore you shall tell my servant David this, 'Thus says Yahweh of Armies, "I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, that you should be prince over my people, over Israel.

title: 2 Samuel 7:9
text: I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a great name, like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.

title: 2 Samuel 7:10
text: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as at the first,

title: 2 Samuel 7:11
text: and as from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will cause you to rest from all your enemies. Moreover Yahweh tells you that Yahweh will make you a house.

title: 2 Samuel 7:12
text: When your days are fulfilled, and you shall sleep with your fathers, I will set up your seed after you, who shall proceed out of your bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.

title: 2 Samuel 7:13
text: He shall build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

title: 2 Samuel 7:14
text: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men;

title: 2 Samuel 7:15
text: but my loving kindness shall not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you.

title: 2 Samuel 7:16
text: Your house and your kingdom shall be made sure forever before you. Your throne shall be established forever."'"

title: 2 Samuel 7:17
text: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

title: 2 Samuel 7:18
text: Then David the king went in, and sat before Yahweh; and he said, "Who am I, Lord Yahweh, and what is my house, that you have brought me thus far?

title: 2 Samuel 7:19
text: This was yet a small thing in your eyes, Lord Yahweh; but you have spoken also of your servant's house for a great while to come; and this after the way of men, Lord Yahweh!

title: 2 Samuel 7:20
text: What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Lord Yahweh.

title: 2 Samuel 7:21
text: For your word's sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it.

title: 2 Samuel 7:22
text: Therefore you are great, Yahweh God. For there is none like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

title: 2 Samuel 7:23
text: What one nation in the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make him a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeem to you out of Egypt, [from] the nations and their gods?

title: 2 Samuel 7:24
text: You established for yourself your people Israel to be a people to you forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.

title: 2 Samuel 7:25
text: Now, Yahweh God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever, and do as you have spoken.

title: 2 Samuel 7:26
text: Let your name be magnified forever, saying, 'Yahweh of Armies is God over Israel; and the house of your servant David shall be established before you.'

title: 2 Samuel 7:27
text: For you, Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed to your servant, saying, 'I will build you a house.' Therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to you.

title: 2 Samuel 7:28
text: "Now, O Lord Yahweh, you are God, and your words are truth, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.

title: 2 Samuel 7:29
text: Now therefore let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Lord Yahweh, have spoken it. Let the house of your servant be blessed forever with your blessing."

title: 2 Samuel 8:1
text: After this it happened that David struck the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.

title: 2 Samuel 8:2
text: He struck Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.

title: 2 Samuel 8:3
text: David struck also Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.

title: 2 Samuel 8:4
text: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for one hundred chariots.

title: 2 Samuel 8:5
text: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

title: 2 Samuel 8:6
text: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

title: 2 Samuel 8:7
text: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

title: 2 Samuel 8:8
text: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.

title: 2 Samuel 8:9
text: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,

title: 2 Samuel 8:10
text: then Toi sent Joram his son to king David, to Greet him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. [Joram] brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:

title: 2 Samuel 8:11
text: These also did king David dedicate to Yahweh, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued;

title: 2 Samuel 8:12
