text: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn't see. He walks on the vault of the sky.'

title: Job 22:15
text: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

title: Job 22:16
text: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

title: Job 22:17
text: who said to God, 'Depart from us;' and, 'What can the Almighty do for us?'

title: Job 22:18
text: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

title: Job 22:19
text: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

title: Job 22:20
text: saying, 'Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed the remnant of them.'

title: Job 22:21
text: "Acquaint yourself with him, now, and be at peace. Thereby good shall come to you.

title: Job 22:22
text: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

title: Job 22:23
text: If you return to the Almighty, you shall be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

title: Job 22:24
text: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

title: Job 22:25
text: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.

title: Job 22:26
text: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and shall lift up your face to God.

title: Job 22:27
text: You shall make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You shall pay your vows.

title: Job 22:28
text: You shall also decree a thing, and it shall be established to you. Light shall shine on your ways.

title: Job 22:29
text: When they cast down, you shall say, 'be lifted up.' He will save the humble person.

title: Job 22:30
text: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he shall be delivered through the cleanness of your hands."

title: Job 23:1
text: Then Job answered,

title: Job 23:2
text: "Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

title: Job 23:3
text: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

title: Job 23:4
text: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

title: Job 23:5
text: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

title: Job 23:6
text: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

title: Job 23:7
text: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

title: Job 23:8
text: "If I go east, he is not there; if west, I can't find him;

title: Job 23:9
text: He works to the north, but I can't see him. He turns south, but I can't catch a glimpse of him.

title: Job 23:10
text: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I shall come forth like gold.

title: Job 23:11
text: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned aside.

title: Job 23:12
text: I haven't gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

title: Job 23:13
text: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

title: Job 23:14
text: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

title: Job 23:15
text: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.

title: Job 23:16
text: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

title: Job 23:17
text: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.

title: Job 24:1
text: "Why aren't times laid up by the Almighty? Why don't those who know him see his days?

title: Job 24:2
text: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

title: Job 24:3
text: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow's ox for a pledge.

title: Job 24:4
text: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.

title: Job 24:5
text: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go forth to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.

title: Job 24:6
text: They cut their provender in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.

title: Job 24:7
text: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.

title: Job 24:8
text: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.

title: Job 24:9
text: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,

title: Job 24:10
text: So that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.

title: Job 24:11
text: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.

title: Job 24:12
text: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn't regard the folly.

title: Job 24:13
text: "These are of those who rebel against the light. They don't know its ways, nor stay in its paths.

title: Job 24:14
text: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.

title: Job 24:15
text: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, 'No eye shall see me.' He disguises his face.

title: Job 24:16
text: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don't know the light.

title: Job 24:17
text: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.

title: Job 24:18
text: "They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed in the earth. They don't turn into the way of the vineyards.

title: Job 24:19
text: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.

title: Job 24:20
text: The womb shall forget him. The worm shall feed sweetly on him. He shall be no more remembered. Unrighteousness shall be broken as a tree.

title: Job 24:21
text: He devours the barren who don't bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.

title: Job 24:22
text: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.

title: Job 24:23
text: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.

title: Job 24:24
text: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.

title: Job 24:25
text: If it isn't so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?"

title: Job 25:1
text: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

title: Job 25:2
text: "Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.

title: Job 25:3
text: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?

title: Job 25:4
text: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?

title: Job 25:5
text: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;

title: Job 25:6
text: How much less man, who is a worm, the son of man, who is a worm!"

title: Job 26:1
text: Then Job answered,

title: Job 26:2
text: "How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

title: Job 26:3
text: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

title: Job 26:4
text: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came forth from you?

title: Job 26:5
text: "Those who are deceased tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

title: Job 26:6
text: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

title: Job 26:7
text: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.

title: Job 26:8
text: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.

title: Job 26:9
text: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

title: Job 26:10
text: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.

title: Job 26:11
text: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

title: Job 26:12
text: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

title: Job 26:13
text: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

title: Job 26:14
text: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?"

title: Job 27:1
text: Job again took up his parable, and said,

title: Job 27:2
text: "As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter.

title: Job 27:3
text: (For the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

title: Job 27:4
text: surely my lips shall not speak unrighteousness, neither shall my tongue utter deceit.

title: Job 27:5
text: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

title: Job 27:6
text: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.

title: Job 27:7
text: "Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

title: Job 27:8
text: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

title: Job 27:9
text: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

title: Job 27:10
text: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?

title: Job 27:11
text: I will teach you about the hand of God. That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

title: Job 27:12
text: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?

title: Job 27:13
text: "This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

title: Job 27:14
text: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

title: Job 27:15
text: Those who remain of him shall be buried in death. His widows shall make no lamentation.

title: Job 27:16
text: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

title: Job 27:17
text: he may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.

title: Job 27:18
text: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

title: Job 27:19
text: He lies down rich, but he shall not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

title: Job 27:20
text: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.

title: Job 27:21
text: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.

title: Job 27:22
text: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.

title: Job 27:23
text: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.

title: Job 28:1
text: "Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

title: Job 28:2
text: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

title: Job 28:3
text: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

title: Job 28:4
text: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

title: Job 28:5
text: As for the earth, out of it comes bread; Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

title: Job 28:6
text: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.

title: Job 28:7
text: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon's eye seen it.

title: Job 28:8
text: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

title: Job 28:9
text: He puts forth his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

title: Job 28:10
text: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.

title: Job 28:11
text: He binds the streams that they don't trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings forth to light.

title: Job 28:12
text: "But where shall wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?

title: Job 28:13
text: Man doesn't know its price; Neither is it found in the land of the living.

title: Job 28:14
text: The deep says, 'It isn't in me.' The sea says, 'It isn't with me.'

title: Job 28:15
text: It can't be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for its price.

title: Job 28:16
text: It can't be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

title: Job 28:17
text: Gold and glass can't equal it, neither shall it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

title: Job 28:18
text: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

title: Job 28:19
text: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, Neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

title: Job 28:20
text: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?

title: Job 28:21
text: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

title: Job 28:22
text: Destruction and Death say, 'We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.'

title: Job 28:23
text: "God understands its way, and he knows its place.

title: Job 28:24
text: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

title: Job 28:25
text: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

title: Job 28:26
text: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder;

title: Job 28:27
text: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.

title: Job 28:28
text: To man he said, 'Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.'"

title: Job 29:1
text: Job again took up his parable, and said,

title: Job 29:2
text: "Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

title: Job 29:3
text: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

title: Job 29:4
text: as I was in the ripeness of my days, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

title: Job 29:5
text: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

title: Job 29:6
text: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

title: Job 29:7
text: when I went forth to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

title: Job 29:8
text: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

title: Job 29:9
text: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

title: Job 29:10
text: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

title: Job 29:11
text: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it commended me:

title: Job 29:12
text: Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had none to help him,

title: Job 29:13
text: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.

title: Job 29:14
text: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

title: Job 29:15
text: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

title: Job 29:16
text: I was a father to the needy. The cause of him who I didn't know, I searched out.

title: Job 29:17
text: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous, and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

title: Job 29:18
text: Then I said, 'I shall die in my own house, I shall number my days as the sand.

title: Job 29:19
text: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

title: Job 29:20
text: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.'

title: Job 29:21
text: "Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

title: Job 29:22
text: After my words they didn't speak again. My speech fell on them.

title: Job 29:23
text: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

title: Job 29:24
text: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn't reject the light of my face.

title: Job 29:25
text: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.

title: Job 30:1
text: "But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to put with my sheep dogs.

title: Job 30:2
text: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

title: Job 30:3
text: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

title: Job 30:4
text: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom are their food.

title: Job 30:5
text: They are driven out from the midst of men. They cry after them as after a thief;

title: Job 30:6
text: So that they dwell in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

title: Job 30:7
text: Among the bushes they bray; and under the nettles they are gathered together.

title: Job 30:8
text: They are children of fools, yes, children of base men. They were flogged out of the land.

title: Job 30:9
text: "Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

title: Job 30:10
text: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don't hesitate to spit in my face.

title: Job 30:11
text: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.

title: Job 30:12
text: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet, They cast up against me their ways of destruction.

title: Job 30:13
text: They mar my path, They set forward my calamity, without anyone's help.

title: Job 30:14
text: As through a wide breach they come, in the midst of the ruin they roll themselves in.

title: Job 30:15
text: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

title: Job 30:16
text: "Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold on me.

title: Job 30:17
text: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

title: Job 30:18
text: By great force is my garment disfigured. It binds me about as the collar of my coat.

title: Job 30:19
text: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

title: Job 30:20
text: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.

title: Job 30:21
text: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

title: Job 30:22
text: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.

title: Job 30:23
text: For I know that you will bring me to death, To the house appointed for all living.

title: Job 30:24
text: "However doesn't one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

title: Job 30:25
text: Didn't I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn't my soul grieved for the needy?

title: Job 30:26
text: When I looked for good, then evil came; When I waited for light, there came darkness.

title: Job 30:27
text: My heart is troubled, and doesn't rest. Days of affliction have come on me.

title: Job 30:28
text: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

title: Job 30:29
text: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

title: Job 30:30
text: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

title: Job 30:31
text: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.

title: Job 31:1
text: "I made a covenant with my eyes, how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?

title: Job 31:2
text: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?

title: Job 31:3
text: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?

title: Job 31:4
text: Doesn't he see my ways, and number all my steps?

title: Job 31:5
text: "If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit

title: Job 31:6
text: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);

title: Job 31:7
text: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,

title: Job 31:8
text: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

title: Job 31:9
text: "If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor's door,

title: Job 31:10
text: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.

title: Job 31:11
text: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges:

title: Job 31:12
text: For it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.

title: Job 31:13
text: "If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me;

title: Job 31:14
text: What then shall I do when God rises up? When he visits, what shall I answer him?

title: Job 31:15
text: Didn't he who made me in the womb make him? Didn't one fashion us in the womb?

title: Job 31:16
text: "If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

title: Job 31:17
text: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it

title: Job 31:18
text: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, her have I guided from my mother's womb);

title: Job 31:19
text: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;

title: Job 31:20
text: if his heart hasn't blessed me, if he hasn't been warmed with my sheep's fleece;

title: Job 31:21
text: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate,

title: Job 31:22
text: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.

title: Job 31:23
text: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because his majesty, I can do nothing.

title: Job 31:24
text: "If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, 'You are my confidence;'

title: Job 31:25
text: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

title: Job 31:26
text: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,

title: Job 31:27
text: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth,

title: Job 31:28
text: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges; for I should have denied the God who is above.

title: Job 31:29
text: "If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him;

title: Job 31:30
text: (yes, I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);

title: Job 31:31
text: if the men of my tent have not said, 'Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?'

title: Job 31:32
text: (the foreigner has not lodged in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);

title: Job 31:33
text: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,

title: Job 31:34
text: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn't go out of the door--

title: Job 31:35
text: oh that I had one to hear me! (behold, here is my signature, let the Almighty answer me); let the accuser write my indictment!

title: Job 31:36
text: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder; and I would bind it to me as a crown.

title: Job 31:37
text: I would declare to him the number of my steps. as a prince would I go near to him.

title: Job 31:38
text: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;

title: Job 31:39
text: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,

title: Job 31:40
text: let briars grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley." The words of Job are ended.

title: Job 32:1
text: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

title: Job 32:2
text: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.

title: Job 32:3
text: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

title: Job 32:4
text: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were elder than he.

title: Job 32:5
text: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

title: Job 32:6
text: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, "I am young, and you are very old; Therefore I held back, and didn't dare show you my opinion.

title: Job 32:7
text: I said, 'Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.'

title: Job 32:8
text: But there is a spirit in man, and the breath of the Almighty gives them understanding.

title: Job 32:9
text: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.

title: Job 32:10
text: Therefore I said, 'Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.'

title: Job 32:11
text: "Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.

title: Job 32:12
text: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.

title: Job 32:13
text: Beware lest you say, 'We have found wisdom, God may refute him, not man;'

title: Job 32:14
text: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.

title: Job 32:15
text: "They are amazed. They answer no more. They don't have a word to say.

title: Job 32:16
text: Shall I wait, because they don't speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?

title: Job 32:17
text: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.

title: Job 32:18
text: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.

title: Job 32:19
text: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.

title: Job 32:20
text: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.

title: Job 32:21
text: Please don't let me respect any man's person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.

title: Job 32:22
text: For I don't know how to give flattering titles; or else my Maker would soon take me away.

title: Job 33:1
text: "However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.

title: Job 33:2
text: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

title: Job 33:3
text: My words shall utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they shall speak sincerely.

title: Job 33:4
text: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

title: Job 33:5
text: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand forth.

title: Job 33:6
text: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.

title: Job 33:7
text: Behold, my terror shall not make you afraid, neither shall my pressure be heavy on you.

title: Job 33:8
text: "Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

title: Job 33:9
text: 'I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.

title: Job 33:10
text: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.

title: Job 33:11
text: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.'

title: Job 33:12
text: "Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.

title: Job 33:13
text: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn't give account of any of his matters?

title: Job 33:14
text: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.

title: Job 33:15
text: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed;

title: Job 33:16
text: Then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,

title: Job 33:17
text: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

title: Job 33:18
text: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

title: Job 33:19
text: He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones;

title: Job 33:20
text: So that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.

title: Job 33:21
text: His flesh is so consumed away, that it can't be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.

title: Job 33:22
text: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

title: Job 33:23
text: "If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him;

title: Job 33:24
text: then God is gracious to him, and says, 'Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.'

title: Job 33:25
text: His flesh shall be fresher than a child's. He returns to the days of his youth.

title: Job 33:26
text: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.

title: Job 33:27
text: He sings before men, and says, 'I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn't profit me.

title: Job 33:28
text: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life shall see the light.'

title: Job 33:29
text: "Behold, God works all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,

title: Job 33:30
text: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

title: Job 33:31
text: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.

title: Job 33:32
text: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.

title: Job 33:33
text: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom."

title: Job 34:1
text: Moreover Elihu answered,

title: Job 34:2
text: "Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

title: Job 34:3
text: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.

title: Job 34:4
text: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.

title: Job 34:5
text: For Job has said, 'I am righteous, God has taken away my right:

title: Job 34:6
text: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.'

title: Job 34:7
text: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,

title: Job 34:8
text: Who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

title: Job 34:9
text: For he has said, 'It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.'

title: Job 34:10
text: "Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

title: Job 34:11
text: For the work of a man he will render to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

title: Job 34:12
text: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

title: Job 34:13
text: Who put him in charge of the earth? or who has appointed him over the whole world?

title: Job 34:14
text: If he set his heart on himself, If he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,

title: Job 34:15
text: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.

title: Job 34:16
text: "If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.

title: Job 34:17
text: Shall even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty?--

title: Job 34:18
text: Who says to a king, 'Vile!' or to nobles, 'Wicked!'?

title: Job 34:19
text: Who doesn't respect the persons of princes, nor respects the rich more than the poor; for they all are the work of his hands.

title: Job 34:20
text: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.

title: Job 34:21
text: "For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.

title: Job 34:22
text: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

title: Job 34:23
text: For he doesn't need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.

title: Job 34:24
text: He breaks in pieces mighty men in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.

title: Job 34:25
text: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

title: Job 34:26
text: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

title: Job 34:27
text: because they turned aside from following him, and wouldn't pay attention to any of his ways,

title: Job 34:28
text: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.

title: Job 34:29
text: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? Alike whether to a nation, or to a man,

title: Job 34:30
text: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.

title: Job 34:31
text: "For has any said to God, 'I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.

title: Job 34:32
text: Teach me that which I don't see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more'?

title: Job 34:33
text: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.

title: Job 34:34
text: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:

title: Job 34:35
text: 'Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.'

title: Job 34:36
text: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.

title: Job 34:37
text: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God."

title: Job 35:1
text: Moreover Elihu answered,

title: Job 35:2
text: "Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, 'My righteousness is more than God's,'

title: Job 35:3
text: That you ask, 'What advantage will it be to you? What profit shall I have, more than if I had sinned?'

title: Job 35:4
text: I will answer you, and your companions with you.

title: Job 35:5
text: Look to the heavens, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.

title: Job 35:6
text: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?

title: Job 35:7
text: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?

title: Job 35:8
text: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.

title: Job 35:9
text: "By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

title: Job 35:10
text: But none says, 'Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

title: Job 35:11
text: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?'

title: Job 35:12
text: There they cry, but none gives answer, because of the pride of evil men.

title: Job 35:13
text: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.

title: Job 35:14
text: How much less when you say you don't see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!

title: Job 35:15
text: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance.

title: Job 35:16
text: Therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge."

title: Job 36:1
text: Elihu also continued, and said,

title: Job 36:2
text: "Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God's behalf.

title: Job 36:3
text: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

title: Job 36:4
text: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

title: Job 36:5
text: "Behold, God is mighty, and doesn't despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.

title: Job 36:6
text: He doesn't preserve the life of the wicked, but gives to the afflicted their right.

title: Job 36:7
text: He doesn't withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

title: Job 36:8
text: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,

title: Job 36:9
text: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

title: Job 36:10
text: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.

title: Job 36:11
text: If they listen and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

title: Job 36:12
text: But if they don't listen, they shall perish by the sword; they shall die without knowledge.

title: Job 36:13
text: "But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don't cry for help when he binds them.

title: Job 36:14
text: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.

title: Job 36:15
text: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.

title: Job 36:16
text: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a broad place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

title: Job 36:17
text: "But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.

title: Job 36:18
text: Don't let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

title: Job 36:19
text: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?

title: Job 36:20
text: Don't desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.

title: Job 36:21
text: Take heed, don't regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.

title: Job 36:22
text: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

title: Job 36:23
text: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, 'You have committed unrighteousness?'

title: Job 36:24
text: "Remember that you magnify his work, whereof men have sung.

title: Job 36:25
text: All men have looked thereon. Man sees it afar off.

title: Job 36:26
text: Behold, God is great, and we don't know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.

title: Job 36:27
text: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,

title: Job 36:28
text: Which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.

title: Job 36:29
text: Yes, can any understand the spreading of the clouds, and the thunderings of his pavilion?

title: Job 36:30
text: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.

title: Job 36:31
text: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.

title: Job 36:32
text: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.

title: Job 36:33
text: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also concerning the storm that comes up.

title: Job 37:1
text: "Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

title: Job 37:2
text: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.

title: Job 37:3
text: He sends it forth under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

title: Job 37:4
text: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn't hold back anything when his voice is heard.

title: Job 37:5
text: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can't comprehend.

title: Job 37:6
text: For he says to the snow, 'Fall on the earth;' likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.

title: Job 37:7
text: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.

title: Job 37:8
text: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.

title: Job 37:9
text: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.

title: Job 37:10
text: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the breadth of the waters is frozen.

title: Job 37:11
text: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.

title: Job 37:12
text: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,

title: Job 37:13
text: Whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.

title: Job 37:14
text: "Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

title: Job 37:15
text: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

title: Job 37:16
text: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

title: Job 37:17
text: You whose clothing is warm, when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

title: Job 37:18
text: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?

title: Job 37:19
text: Teach us what we shall tell him, for we can't make our case by reason of darkness.

title: Job 37:20
text: Shall it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

title: Job 37:21
text: Now men don't see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.

title: Job 37:22
text: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.

title: Job 37:23
text: We can't reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

title: Job 37:24
text: Therefore men revere him. He doesn't regard any who are wise of heart."

title: Job 38:1
text: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,

title: Job 38:2
text: "Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

title: Job 38:3
text: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!

title: Job 38:4
text: "Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.

title: Job 38:5
text: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?

title: Job 38:6
text: Whereupon were its foundations fastened? Or who laid its cornerstone,

title: Job 38:7
text: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

title: Job 38:8
text: "Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke forth from the womb,

title: Job 38:9
text: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,

title: Job 38:10
text: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,

title: Job 38:11
text: and said, 'Here you may come, but no further. Here your proud waves shall be stayed?'

title: Job 38:12
text: "Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place;

title: Job 38:13
text: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?

title: Job 38:14
text: It is changed as clay under the seal, and stands forth as a garment.

title: Job 38:15
text: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.

title: Job 38:16
text: "Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?

title: Job 38:17
text: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

title: Job 38:18
text: Have you comprehended the earth in its breadth? Declare, if you know it all.

title: Job 38:19
text: "What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,

title: Job 38:20
text: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?

title: Job 38:21
text: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!

title: Job 38:22
text: Have you entered the treasuries of the snow, or have you seen the treasures of the hail,

title: Job 38:23
text: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

title: Job 38:24
text: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?

title: Job 38:25
text: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm;

title: Job 38:26
text: To cause it to rain on a land where no man is; on the wilderness, in which there is no man;

title: Job 38:27
text: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to spring forth?

title: Job 38:28
text: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?

title: Job 38:29
text: Out of whose womb came the ice? The gray frost of the sky, who has given birth to it?

title: Job 38:30
text: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.

title: Job 38:31
text: "Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

title: Job 38:32
text: Can you lead forth the constellations in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?

title: Job 38:33
text: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?

title: Job 38:34
text: "Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, That abundance of waters may cover you?

title: Job 38:35
text: Can you send forth lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, 'Here we are?'

title: Job 38:36
text: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?

title: Job 38:37
text: Who can number the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the bottles of the sky,

title: Job 38:38
text: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?

title: Job 38:39
text: "Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

title: Job 38:40
text: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?

title: Job 38:41
text: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?

title: Job 39:1
text: "Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?

title: Job 39:2
text: Can you number the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?

title: Job 39:3
text: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young, they end their labor pains.

title: Job 39:4
text: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go forth, and don't return again.

title: Job 39:5
text: "Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,

title: Job 39:6
text: Whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?

title: Job 39:7
text: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.

title: Job 39:8
text: The range of the mountains is his pasture, He searches after every green thing.

title: Job 39:9
text: "Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?

title: Job 39:10
text: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?

title: Job 39:11
text: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?

title: Job 39:12
text: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?

title: Job 39:13
text: "The wings of the ostrich wave proudly; but are they the feathers and plumage of love?

title: Job 39:14
text: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,

title: Job 39:15
text: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them.

title: Job 39:16
text: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,

title: Job 39:17
text: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.

title: Job 39:18
text: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.

title: Job 39:19
text: "Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?

title: Job 39:20
text: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.

title: Job 39:21
text: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.

title: Job 39:22
text: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.

title: Job 39:23
text: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.

title: Job 39:24
text: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.

title: Job 39:25
text: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, 'Aha!' He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

title: Job 39:26
text: "Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?

title: Job 39:27
text: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?

title: Job 39:28
text: On the cliff he dwells, and makes his home, on the point of the cliff, and the stronghold.

title: Job 39:29
text: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.

title: Job 39:30
text: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is."

title: Job 40:1
text: Moreover Yahweh answered Job,

title: Job 40:2
text: "Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it."

title: Job 40:3
text: Then Job answered Yahweh,

title: Job 40:4
text: "Behold, I am of small account. What shall I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.

title: Job 40:5
text: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further."

title: Job 40:6
text: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,

title: Job 40:7
text: "Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.

title: Job 40:8
text: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

title: Job 40:9
text: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?

title: Job 40:10
text: "Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.

title: Job 40:11
text: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.

title: Job 40:12
text: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.

title: Job 40:13
text: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.

title: Job 40:14
text: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

title: Job 40:15
text: "See now, behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.

title: Job 40:16
text: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.

title: Job 40:17
text: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

title: Job 40:18
text: His bones are like tubes of brass. His limbs are like bars of iron.

title: Job 40:19
text: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.

title: Job 40:20
text: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.

title: Job 40:21
text: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.

title: Job 40:22
text: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.

title: Job 40:23
text: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn't tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.

title: Job 40:24
text: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?

title: Job 41:1
text: "Can you draw out Leviathan with a fishhook, or press down his tongue with a cord?

title: Job 41:2
text: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

title: Job 41:3
text: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?

title: Job 41:4
text: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?

title: Job 41:5
text: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?

title: Job 41:6
text: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?

title: Job 41:7
text: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?

title: Job 41:8
text: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.

title: Job 41:9
text: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won't one be cast down even at the sight of him?

title: Job 41:10
text: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?

title: Job 41:11
text: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.

title: Job 41:12
text: "I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.

title: Job 41:13
text: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who shall come within his jaws?

title: Job 41:14
text: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.

title: Job 41:15
text: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.

title: Job 41:16
text: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

title: Job 41:17
text: They are joined one to another. They stick together, so that they can't be pulled apart.

title: Job 41:18
text: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

title: Job 41:19
text: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap forth.

title: Job 41:20
text: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

title: Job 41:21
text: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes forth from his mouth.

title: Job 41:22
text: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.

title: Job 41:23
text: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can't be moved.

title: Job 41:24
text: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.

title: Job 41:25
text: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.

title: Job 41:26
text: If one attacks him with the sword, it can't prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

title: Job 41:27
text: He counts iron as straw; and brass as rotten wood.

title: Job 41:28
text: The arrow can't make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.

title: Job 41:29
text: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.

title: Job 41:30
text: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

title: Job 41:31
text: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

title: Job 41:32
text: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.

title: Job 41:33
text: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.

title: Job 41:34
text: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride."

title: Job 42:1
text: Then Job answered Yahweh,

title: Job 42:2
text: "I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.

title: Job 42:3
text: You asked, 'Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?' therefore I have uttered that which I did not understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn't know.

title: Job 42:4
text: You said, 'Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.'

title: Job 42:5
text: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.

title: Job 42:6
text: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes."

title: Job 42:7
text: It was so, that after Yahweh had spoken these words to Job, Yahweh said to Eliphaz the Temanite, "My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.

title: Job 42:8
text: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has."

title: Job 42:9
text: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did what Yahweh commanded them, and Yahweh accepted Job.

title: Job 42:10
text: Yahweh turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends. Yahweh gave Job twice as much as he had before.

title: Job 42:11
text: Then came there to him all his brothers, and all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that Yahweh had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.

title: Job 42:12
text: So Yahweh blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.

title: Job 42:13
text: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

title: Job 42:14
text: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.

title: Job 42:15
text: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.

title: Job 42:16
text: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, to four generations.

title: Job 42:17
text: So Job died, being old and full of days. BOOK I

title: Psalms 1:1
text: Blessed is the man who doesn't walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand in the way of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

title: Psalms 1:2
text: but his delight is in Yahweh's law. On his law he meditates day and night.

title: Psalms 1:3
text: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that brings forth its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

title: Psalms 1:4
text: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

title: Psalms 1:5
text: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

title: Psalms 1:6
text: For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

title: Psalms 2:1
text: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

title: Psalms 2:2
text: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed, saying,

title: Psalms 2:3
text: "Let's break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us."

title: Psalms 2:4
text: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.

title: Psalms 2:5
text: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

title: Psalms 2:6
text: "Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion."

title: Psalms 2:7
text: I will tell of the decree. Yahweh said to me, "You are my son. Today I have become your father.

title: Psalms 2:8
text: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

title: Psalms 2:9
text: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel."

title: Psalms 2:10
text: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

title: Psalms 2:11
text: Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

title: Psalms 2:12
text: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish in the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him. A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son.

title: Psalms 3
inscription: A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.

title: Psalms 3:1
text: Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

title: Psalms 3:2
text: Many there are who say of my soul, "There is no help for him in God." Selah.

title: Psalms 3:3
text: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

title: Psalms 3:4
text: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

title: Psalms 3:5
text: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened; for Yahweh sustains me.

title: Psalms 3:6
text: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

title: Psalms 3:7
text: Arise, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

title: Psalms 3:8
text: Salvation belongs to Yahweh. Your blessing be on your people. Selah. For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David.

title: Psalms 4
inscription: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm of David.

title: Psalms 4:1
text: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

title: Psalms 4:2
text: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity, and seek after falsehood? Selah.

title: Psalms 4:3
text: But know that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly: Yahweh will hear when I call to him.

title: Psalms 4:4
text: Stand in awe, and don't sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

title: Psalms 4:5
text: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in Yahweh.

title: Psalms 4:6
text: Many say, "Who will show us any good?" Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.

title: Psalms 4:7
text: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

title: Psalms 4:8
text: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety. For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David.

title: Psalms 5
inscription: To the chief Musician upon Nehiloth, A Psalm of David.

title: Psalms 5:1
text: Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.

title: Psalms 5:2
text: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for to you do I pray.

title: Psalms 5:3
text: Yahweh, in the morning you shall hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

title: Psalms 5:4
text: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can't live with you.

title: Psalms 5:5
text: The arrogant shall not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

title: Psalms 5:6
text: You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

title: Psalms 5:7
text: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

title: Psalms 5:8
text: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

title: Psalms 5:9
text: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

title: Psalms 5:10
text: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels; Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

title: Psalms 5:11
text: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice, Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

title: Psalms 5:12
text: For you will bless the righteous. Yahweh, you will surround him with favor as with a shield. For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David.

title: Psalms 6
inscription: To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.

title: Psalms 6:1
text: Yahweh, don't rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

title: Psalms 6:2
text: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

title: Psalms 6:3
text: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, Yahweh--how long?

title: Psalms 6:4
text: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness' sake.

title: Psalms 6:5
text: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?

title: Psalms 6:6
text: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.

title: Psalms 6:7
text: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.

title: Psalms 6:8
text: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.

title: Psalms 6:9
text: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.

title: Psalms 6:10
text: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly. A meditation by David, which he sang to Yahweh, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite.

title: Psalms 7
inscription: Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the LORD, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.

title: Psalms 7:1
text: Yahweh, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

title: Psalms 7:2
text: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

title: Psalms 7:3
text: Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

title: Psalms 7:4
text: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, if I have delivered him who without cause was my adversary),

title: Psalms 7:5
text: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

title: Psalms 7:6
text: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

title: Psalms 7:7
text: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

title: Psalms 7:8
text: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

title: Psalms 7:9
text: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

title: Psalms 7:10
text: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

title: Psalms 7:11
text: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

title: Psalms 7:12
text: If a man doesn't relent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

title: Psalms 7:13
text: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

title: Psalms 7:14
text: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

title: Psalms 7:15
text: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

title: Psalms 7:16
text: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

title: Psalms 7:17
text: I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High. For the Chief Musician; on an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by David.

title: Psalms 8
inscription: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of David.

title: Psalms 8:1
text: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth, who has set your glory above the heavens!

title: Psalms 8:2
text: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

title: Psalms 8:3
text: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;

title: Psalms 8:4
text: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

title: Psalms 8:5
text: For you have made him a little lower than God, and crowned him with glory and honor.

title: Psalms 8:6
text: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

title: Psalms 8:7
text: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,

title: Psalms 8:8
text: The birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

title: Psalms 8:9
text: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! For the Chief Musician. Set to "The Death of the Son." A Psalm by David.

title: Psalms 9
inscription: To the chief Musician upon Muthlabben, A Psalm of David.

title: Psalms 9:1
text: I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

title: Psalms 9:2
text: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

title: Psalms 9:3
text: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

title: Psalms 9:4
text: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

title: Psalms 9:5
text: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

title: Psalms 9:6
text: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

title: Psalms 9:7
text: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

title: Psalms 9:8
text: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

title: Psalms 9:9
text: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

title: Psalms 9:10
text: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.

title: Psalms 9:11
text: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

title: Psalms 9:12
text: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn't forget the cry of the afflicted.

title: Psalms 9:13
text: Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death;

title: Psalms 9:14
text: that I may show forth all your praise. In the gates of the daughter of Zion, I will rejoice in your salvation.

title: Psalms 9:15
text: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

title: Psalms 9:16
text: Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.

title: Psalms 9:17
text: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

title: Psalms 9:18
text: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

title: Psalms 9:19
text: Arise, Yahweh! Don't let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

title: Psalms 9:20
text: Put them in fear, Yahweh. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.

title: Psalms 10:1
text: Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

title: Psalms 10:2
text: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.

title: Psalms 10:3
text: For the wicked boasts of his heart's cravings. He blesses the greedy, and condemns Yahweh.

title: Psalms 10:4
text: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.

title: Psalms 10:5
text: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is haughty, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.

title: Psalms 10:6
text: He says in his heart, "I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble."

title: Psalms 10:7
text: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

title: Psalms 10:8
text: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.

title: Psalms 10:9
text: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless, when he draws him in his net.

title: Psalms 10:10
text: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.

title: Psalms 10:11
text: He says in his heart, "God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it."

title: Psalms 10:12
text: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don't forget the helpless.

title: Psalms 10:13
text: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, "God won't call me into account?"

title: Psalms 10:14
text: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.

title: Psalms 10:15
text: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

title: Psalms 10:16
text: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.

title: Psalms 10:17
text: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,

title: Psalms 10:18
text: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more. For the Chief Musician. By David.

title: Psalms 11
inscription: To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David.

title: Psalms 11:1
text: In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, "Flee as a bird to your mountain!"

title: Psalms 11:2
text: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

title: Psalms 11:3
text: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

title: Psalms 11:4
text: Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.

title: Psalms 11:5
text: Yahweh examines the righteous, but the wicked and him who loves violence his soul hates.

title: Psalms 11:6
text: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

title: Psalms 11:7
text: For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face. For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David.

title: Psalms 12
inscription: To the chief Musician upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.

title: Psalms 12:1
text: Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

title: Psalms 12:2
text: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.

title: Psalms 12:3
text: May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

title: Psalms 12:4
text: who have said, "With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?"

title: Psalms 12:5
text: "Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise," says Yahweh; "I will set him in safety from those who malign him."

title: Psalms 12:6
text: The words of Yahweh are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

title: Psalms 12:7
text: You will keep them, Yahweh. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

title: Psalms 12:8
text: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men. For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

title: Psalms 13
inscription: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

title: Psalms 13:1
text: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

title: Psalms 13:2
text: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

title: Psalms 13:3
text: Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

title: Psalms 13:4
text: Lest my enemy say, "I have prevailed against him;" Lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

title: Psalms 13:5
text: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.

title: Psalms 13:6
text: I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me. For the Chief Musician. By David.

title: Psalms 14
inscription: To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David.

title: Psalms 14:1
text: The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt. They have done abominable works. There is none who does good.

title: Psalms 14:2
text: Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who did understand, who did seek after God.

title: Psalms 14:3
text: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is none who does good, no, not one.

title: Psalms 14:4
text: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don't call on Yahweh?

title: Psalms 14:5
text: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

title: Psalms 14:6
text: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because Yahweh is his refuge.

title: Psalms 14:7
text: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When Yahweh restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad. A Psalm by David.

title: Psalms 15
inscription: A Psalm of David.

title: Psalms 15:1
text: Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

title: Psalms 15:2
text: He who walks blamelessly does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;

title: Psalms 15:3
text: He who doesn't slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

title: Psalms 15:4
text: In whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn't change;

title: Psalms 15:5
text: he who doesn't lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken. A Poem by David.

title: Psalms 16
inscription: Michtam of David.

title: Psalms 16:1
text: Preserve me, God, for in you do I take refuge.

title: Psalms 16:2
text: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, "You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing."

title: Psalms 16:3
text: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

title: Psalms 16:4
text: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.

title: Psalms 16:5
text: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.

title: Psalms 16:6
text: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.

title: Psalms 16:7
text: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

title: Psalms 16:8
text: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

title: Psalms 16:9
text: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.

title: Psalms 16:10
text: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

title: Psalms 16:11
text: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forevermore. A Prayer by David.

title: Psalms 17
inscription: A Prayer of David.

title: Psalms 17:1
text: Hear, Yahweh, my righteous plea; Give ear to my prayer, that doesn't go out of deceitful lips.

title: Psalms 17:2
text: Let my sentence come forth from your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.

title: Psalms 17:3
text: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.

title: Psalms 17:4
