title: Psalms 55:4
text: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

title: Psalms 55:5
text: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

title: Psalms 55:6
text: I said, "Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

title: Psalms 55:7
text: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness." Selah.

title: Psalms 55:8
text: "I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm."

title: Psalms 55:9
text: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

title: Psalms 55:10
text: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

title: Psalms 55:11
text: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don't depart from her streets.

title: Psalms 55:12
text: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

title: Psalms 55:13
text: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

title: Psalms 55:14
text: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God's house with company.

title: Psalms 55:15
text: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is in their dwelling, in the midst of them.

title: Psalms 55:16
text: As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.

title: Psalms 55:17
text: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

title: Psalms 55:18
text: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

title: Psalms 55:19
text: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear, and answer them. Selah. They never change, who don't fear God.

title: Psalms 55:20
text: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

title: Psalms 55:21
text: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

title: Psalms 55:22
text: Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

title: Psalms 55:23
text: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Silent Dove in Distant Lands." A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath.

title: Psalms 56
inscription: To the chief Musician upon Jonathelemrechokim, Michtam of David, when the Philistines took him in Gath.

title: Psalms 56:1
text: Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

title: Psalms 56:2
text: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

title: Psalms 56:3
text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

title: Psalms 56:4
text: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

title: Psalms 56:5
text: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

title: Psalms 56:6
text: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps, they are eager to take my life.

title: Psalms 56:7
text: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

title: Psalms 56:8
text: You number my wanderings. You put my tears into your bottle. Aren't they in your book?

title: Psalms 56:9
text: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this, that God is for me.

title: Psalms 56:10
text: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.

title: Psalms 56:11
text: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

title: Psalms 56:12
text: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

title: Psalms 56:13
text: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Do Not Destroy." A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave.

title: Psalms 57
inscription: To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David, when he fled from Saul in the cave.

title: Psalms 57:1
text: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

title: Psalms 57:2
text: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

title: Psalms 57:3
text: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

title: Psalms 57:4
text: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

title: Psalms 57:5
text: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

title: Psalms 57:6
text: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into its midst themselves. Selah.

title: Psalms 57:7
text: My heart is steadfast, God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

title: Psalms 57:8
text: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, psaltery and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

title: Psalms 57:9
text: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

title: Psalms 57:10
text: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

title: Psalms 57:11
text: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Do Not Destroy." A poem by David.

title: Psalms 58
inscription: To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David.

title: Psalms 58:1
text: Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

title: Psalms 58:2
text: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.

title: Psalms 58:3
text: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

title: Psalms 58:4
text: Their poison is like the poison of a snake; like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

title: Psalms 58:5
text: which doesn't listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

title: Psalms 58:6
text: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.

title: Psalms 58:7
text: Let them vanish as water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

title: Psalms 58:8
text: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

title: Psalms 58:9
text: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

title: Psalms 58:10
text: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked;

title: Psalms 58:11
text: so that men shall say, "Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth." For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Do Not Destroy." A poem by David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.

title: Psalms 59
inscription: To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.

title: Psalms 59:1
text: Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

title: Psalms 59:2
text: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

title: Psalms 59:3
text: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, Yahweh.

title: Psalms 59:4
text: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!

title: Psalms 59:5
text: You, Yahweh God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.

title: Psalms 59:6
text: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

title: Psalms 59:7
text: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, "For," they say, "who hears us?"

title: Psalms 59:8
text: But you, Yahweh, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

title: Psalms 59:9
text: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

title: Psalms 59:10
text: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

title: Psalms 59:11
text: Don't kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

title: Psalms 59:12
text: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

title: Psalms 59:13
text: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.

title: Psalms 59:14
text: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

title: Psalms 59:15
text: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren't satisfied.

title: Psalms 59:16
text: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.

title: Psalms 59:17
text: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "The Lily of the Covenant." A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt.

title: Psalms 60
inscription: To the chief Musician upon Shushaneduth, Michtam of David, to teach; when he strove with Aramnaharaim and with Aramzobah, when Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the valley of salt twelve thousand.

title: Psalms 60:1
text: God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

title: Psalms 60:2
text: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.

title: Psalms 60:3
text: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

title: Psalms 60:4
text: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

title: Psalms 60:5
text: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

title: Psalms 60:6
text: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

title: Psalms 60:7
text: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

title: Psalms 60:8
text: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my shoe on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia."

title: Psalms 60:9
text: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

title: Psalms 60:10
text: Haven't you, God, rejected us? You don't go out with our armies, God.

title: Psalms 60:11
text: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

title: Psalms 60:12
text: Through God we shall do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries. For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David.

title: Psalms 61
inscription: To the chief Musician upon Neginah, [A Psalm] of David.

title: Psalms 61:1
text: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.

title: Psalms 61:2
text: From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

title: Psalms 61:3
text: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

title: Psalms 61:4
text: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

title: Psalms 61:5
text: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

title: Psalms 61:6
text: You will prolong the king's life; his years shall be for generations.

title: Psalms 61:7
text: He shall be enthroned in God's presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

title: Psalms 61:8
text: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily. For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthan. A Psalm by David.

title: Psalms 62
inscription: To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.

title: Psalms 62:1
text: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

title: Psalms 62:2
text: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress-- I will never be greatly shaken.

title: Psalms 62:3
text: How long will you assault a man, would all of you throw him down, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

title: Psalms 62:4
text: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

title: Psalms 62:5
text: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

title: Psalms 62:6
text: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

title: Psalms 62:7
text: With God is my salvation and my honor. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

title: Psalms 62:8
text: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

title: Psalms 62:9
text: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.

title: Psalms 62:10
text: Don't trust in oppression. Don't become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don't set your heart on them.

title: Psalms 62:11
text: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.

title: Psalms 62:12
text: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work. A Psalm by David, when he was in the desert of Judah.

title: Psalms 63
inscription: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.

title: Psalms 63:1
text: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

title: Psalms 63:2
text: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

title: Psalms 63:3
text: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

title: Psalms 63:4
text: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

title: Psalms 63:5
text: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,

title: Psalms 63:6
text: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.

title: Psalms 63:7
text: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

title: Psalms 63:8
text: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.

title: Psalms 63:9
text: But those who seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

title: Psalms 63:10
text: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.

title: Psalms 63:11
text: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced. For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

title: Psalms 64
inscription: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

title: Psalms 64:1
text: Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

title: Psalms 64:2
text: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

title: Psalms 64:3
text: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,

title: Psalms 64:4
text: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

title: Psalms 64:5
text: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, "Who will see them?"

title: Psalms 64:6
text: They plot injustice, saying, "We have made a perfect plan!" Surely man's mind and heart are cunning.

title: Psalms 64:7
text: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

title: Psalms 64:8
text: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.

title: Psalms 64:9
text: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.

title: Psalms 64:10
text: The righteous shall be glad in Yahweh, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him! For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song.

title: Psalms 65
inscription: To the chief Musician, A Psalm [and] Song of David.

title: Psalms 65:1
text: Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. To you shall vows be performed.

title: Psalms 65:2
text: You who hear prayer, to you all men will come.

title: Psalms 65:3
text: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

title: Psalms 65:4
text: Blessed is one whom you choose, and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

title: Psalms 65:5
text: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea;

title: Psalms 65:6
text: Who by his power forms the mountains, having armed yourself with strength;

title: Psalms 65:7
text: who stills the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

title: Psalms 65:8
text: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning's dawn and the evening with songs of joy.

title: Psalms 65:9
text: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

title: Psalms 65:10
text: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

title: Psalms 65:11
text: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

title: Psalms 65:12
text: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.

title: Psalms 65:13
text: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing. For the Chief Musician. A song. A Psalm.

title: Psalms 66
inscription: To the chief Musician, A Song [or] Psalm.

title: Psalms 66:1
text: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

title: Psalms 66:2
text: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!

title: Psalms 66:3
text: Tell God, "How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.

title: Psalms 66:4
text: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name." Selah.

title: Psalms 66:5
text: Come, and see God's deeds-- awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

title: Psalms 66:6
text: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

title: Psalms 66:7
text: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don't let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.

title: Psalms 66:8
text: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,

title: Psalms 66:9
text: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn't allow our feet to be moved.

title: Psalms 66:10
text: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.

title: Psalms 66:11
text: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.

title: Psalms 66:12
text: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

title: Psalms 66:13
text: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

title: Psalms 66:14
text: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

title: Psalms 66:15
text: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

title: Psalms 66:16
text: Come, and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

title: Psalms 66:17
text: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.

title: Psalms 66:18
text: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn't have listened.

title: Psalms 66:19
text: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.

title: Psalms 66:20
text: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me. For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song.

title: Psalms 67
inscription: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm [or] Song.

title: Psalms 67:1
text: May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

title: Psalms 67:2
text: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

title: Psalms 67:3
text: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

title: Psalms 67:4
text: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

title: Psalms 67:5
text: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

title: Psalms 67:6
text: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

title: Psalms 67:7
text: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him. For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song.

title: Psalms 68
inscription: To the chief Musician, A Psalm [or] Song of David.

title: Psalms 68:1
text: Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.

title: Psalms 68:2
text: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

title: Psalms 68:3
text: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

title: Psalms 68:4
text: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!

title: Psalms 68:5
text: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

title: Psalms 68:6
text: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

title: Psalms 68:7
text: God, when you went forth before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.

title: Psalms 68:8
text: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai-- at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

title: Psalms 68:9
text: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance, when it was weary.

title: Psalms 68:10
text: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

title: Psalms 68:11
text: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.

title: Psalms 68:12
text: "Kings of armies flee! They flee!" She who waits at home divides the spoil,

title: Psalms 68:13
text: while you sleep among the campfires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.

title: Psalms 68:14
text: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.

title: Psalms 68:15
text: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

title: Psalms 68:16
text: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.

title: Psalms 68:17
text: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

title: Psalms 68:18
text: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among men, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.

title: Psalms 68:19
text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

title: Psalms 68:20
text: God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

title: Psalms 68:21
text: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.

title: Psalms 68:22
text: The Lord said, "I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea;

title: Psalms 68:23
text: That you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies."

title: Psalms 68:24
text: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

title: Psalms 68:25
text: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, in the midst of the ladies playing with tambourines,

title: Psalms 68:26
text: "Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!"

title: Psalms 68:27
text: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

title: Psalms 68:28
text: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.

title: Psalms 68:29
text: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.

title: Psalms 68:30
text: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples. Being humbled, may it bring bars of silver. Scatter the nations that delight in war.

title: Psalms 68:31
text: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

title: Psalms 68:32
text: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord! Selah.

title: Psalms 68:33
text: To him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.

title: Psalms 68:34
text: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.

title: Psalms 68:35
text: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God! For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Lilies." By David.

title: Psalms 69
inscription: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, [A Psalm] of David.

title: Psalms 69:1
text: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!

title: Psalms 69:2
text: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

title: Psalms 69:3
text: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail, looking for my God.

title: Psalms 69:4
text: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn't take away.

title: Psalms 69:5
text: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren't hidden from you.

title: Psalms 69:6
text: Don't let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord Yahweh of Armies. Don't let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.

title: Psalms 69:7
text: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.

title: Psalms 69:8
text: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother's children.

title: Psalms 69:9
text: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

title: Psalms 69:10
text: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.

title: Psalms 69:11
text: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.

title: Psalms 69:12
text: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

title: Psalms 69:13
text: But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

title: Psalms 69:14
text: Deliver me out of the mire, and don't let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

title: Psalms 69:15
text: Don't let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don't let the pit shut its mouth on me.

title: Psalms 69:16
text: Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

title: Psalms 69:17
text: Don't hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!

title: Psalms 69:18
text: Draw near to my soul, and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.

title: Psalms 69:19
text: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.

title: Psalms 69:20
text: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.

title: Psalms 69:21
text: They also gave me gall for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.

title: Psalms 69:22
text: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.

title: Psalms 69:23
text: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can't see. Let their backs be continually bent.

title: Psalms 69:24
text: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

title: Psalms 69:25
text: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.

title: Psalms 69:26
text: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.

title: Psalms 69:27
text: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don't let them come into your righteousness.

title: Psalms 69:28
text: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

title: Psalms 69:29
text: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.

title: Psalms 69:30
text: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

title: Psalms 69:31
text: It will please Yahweh better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.

title: Psalms 69:32
text: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.

title: Psalms 69:33
text: For Yahweh hears the needy, and doesn't despise his captive people.

title: Psalms 69:34
text: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!

title: Psalms 69:35
text: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

title: Psalms 69:36
text: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein. For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder.

title: Psalms 70
inscription: To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David, to bring to remembrance.

title: Psalms 70:1
text: Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.

title: Psalms 70:2
text: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

title: Psalms 70:3
text: Let them be turned because of their shame Who say, "Aha! Aha!"

title: Psalms 70:4
text: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, "Let God be exalted!"

title: Psalms 70:5
text: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. Yahweh, don't delay.

title: Psalms 71:1
text: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

title: Psalms 71:2
text: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

title: Psalms 71:3
text: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

title: Psalms 71:4
text: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

title: Psalms 71:5
text: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh; my confidence from my youth.

title: Psalms 71:6
text: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother's womb. I will always praise you.

title: Psalms 71:7
text: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.

title: Psalms 71:8
text: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all the day.

title: Psalms 71:9
text: Don't reject me in my old age. Don't forsake me when my strength fails.

title: Psalms 71:10
text: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

title: Psalms 71:11
text: saying, "God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him."

title: Psalms 71:12
text: God, don't be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

title: Psalms 71:13
text: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

title: Psalms 71:14
text: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

title: Psalms 71:15
text: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don't know its full measure.

title: Psalms 71:16
text: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

title: Psalms 71:17
text: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

title: Psalms 71:18
text: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don't forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

title: Psalms 71:19
text: Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens; you have done great things. God, who is like you?

title: Psalms 71:20
text: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

title: Psalms 71:21
text: Increase my honor, and comfort me again.

title: Psalms 71:22
text: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

title: Psalms 71:23
text: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

title: Psalms 71:24
text: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me. By Solomon.

title: Psalms 72
inscription: [A Psalm] for Solomon.

title: Psalms 72:1
text: God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

title: Psalms 72:2
text: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

title: Psalms 72:3
text: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

title: Psalms 72:4
text: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

title: Psalms 72:5
text: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

title: Psalms 72:6
text: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

title: Psalms 72:7
text: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

title: Psalms 72:8
text: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

title: Psalms 72:9
text: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

title: Psalms 72:10
text: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

title: Psalms 72:11
text: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

title: Psalms 72:12
text: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

title: Psalms 72:13
text: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

title: Psalms 72:14
text: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

title: Psalms 72:15
text: They shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba. Men shall pray for him continually. They shall bless him all day long.

title: Psalms 72:16
text: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

title: Psalms 72:17
text: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

title: Psalms 72:18
text: Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

title: Psalms 72:19
text: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

title: Psalms 72:20
text: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse. BOOK III A Psalm by Asaph.

title: Psalms 73
inscription: A Psalm of Asaph.

title: Psalms 73:1
text: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

title: Psalms 73:2
text: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.

title: Psalms 73:3
text: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

title: Psalms 73:4
text: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.

title: Psalms 73:5
text: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.

title: Psalms 73:6
text: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.

title: Psalms 73:7
text: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

title: Psalms 73:8
text: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.

title: Psalms 73:9
text: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.

title: Psalms 73:10
text: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.

title: Psalms 73:11
text: They say, "How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?"

title: Psalms 73:12
text: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.

title: Psalms 73:13
text: Surely in vain I have cleansed my heart, and washed my hands in innocence,

title: Psalms 73:14
text: For all day long have I been plagued, and punished every morning.

title: Psalms 73:15
text: If I had said, "I will speak thus;" behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.

title: Psalms 73:16
text: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me;

title: Psalms 73:17
text: Until I entered God's sanctuary, and considered their latter end.

title: Psalms 73:18
text: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.

title: Psalms 73:19
text: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

title: Psalms 73:20
text: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

title: Psalms 73:21
text: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.

title: Psalms 73:22
text: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.

title: Psalms 73:23
text: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.

title: Psalms 73:24
text: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

title: Psalms 73:25
text: Who do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth who I desire besides you.

title: Psalms 73:26
text: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

title: Psalms 73:27
text: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

title: Psalms 73:28
text: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works. A contemplation by Asaph.

title: Psalms 74
inscription: Maschil of Asaph.

title: Psalms 74:1
text: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

title: Psalms 74:2
text: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance; Mount Zion, in which you have lived.

title: Psalms 74:3
text: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

title: Psalms 74:4
text: Your adversaries have roared in the midst of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.

title: Psalms 74:5
text: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.

title: Psalms 74:6
text: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.

title: Psalms 74:7
text: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.

title: Psalms 74:8
text: They said in their heart, "We will crush them completely." They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.

title: Psalms 74:9
text: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

title: Psalms 74:10
text: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?

title: Psalms 74:11
text: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it out of your pocket and consume them!

title: Psalms 74:12
text: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

title: Psalms 74:13
text: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

title: Psalms 74:14
text: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.

title: Psalms 74:15
text: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.

title: Psalms 74:16
text: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.

title: Psalms 74:17
text: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.

title: Psalms 74:18
text: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

title: Psalms 74:19
text: Don't deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don't forget the life of your poor forever.

title: Psalms 74:20
text: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

title: Psalms 74:21
text: Don't let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.

title: Psalms 74:22
text: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.

title: Psalms 74:23
text: Don't forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Do Not Destroy." A Psalm by Asaph. A song.

title: Psalms 75
inscription: To the chief Musician, Altaschith, A Psalm [or] Song of Asaph.

title: Psalms 75:1
text: We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

title: Psalms 75:2
text: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

title: Psalms 75:3
text: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

title: Psalms 75:4
text: I said to the arrogant, "Don't boast!" I said to the wicked, "Don't lift up the horn.

title: Psalms 75:5
text: Don't lift up your horn on high. Don't speak with a stiff neck."

title: Psalms 75:6
text: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

title: Psalms 75:7
text: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

title: Psalms 75:8
text: For in the hand of Yahweh there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

title: Psalms 75:9
text: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

title: Psalms 75:10
text: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up. For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song.

title: Psalms 76
inscription: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm [or] Song of Asaph.

title: Psalms 76:1
text: In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.

title: Psalms 76:2
text: His tabernacle is also in Salem; His dwelling place in Zion.

title: Psalms 76:3
text: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.

title: Psalms 76:4
text: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

title: Psalms 76:5
text: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.

title: Psalms 76:6
text: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a deep sleep.

title: Psalms 76:7
text: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

title: Psalms 76:8
text: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,

title: Psalms 76:9
text: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

title: Psalms 76:10
text: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

title: Psalms 76:11
text: Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

title: Psalms 76:12
text: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth. For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph.

title: Psalms 77
inscription: To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Asaph.

title: Psalms 77:1
text: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

title: Psalms 77:2
text: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn't get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

title: Psalms 77:3
text: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

title: Psalms 77:4
text: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can't speak.

title: Psalms 77:5
text: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

title: Psalms 77:6
text: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

title: Psalms 77:7
text: "Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

title: Psalms 77:8
text: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

title: Psalms 77:9
text: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?" Selah.

title: Psalms 77:10
text: Then I thought, "I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High."

title: Psalms 77:11
text: I will remember Yah's deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

title: Psalms 77:12
text: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

title: Psalms 77:13
text: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?

title: Psalms 77:14
text: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

title: Psalms 77:15
text: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

title: Psalms 77:16
text: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.

title: Psalms 77:17
text: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

title: Psalms 77:18
text: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.

title: Psalms 77:19
text: Your way was through the sea; your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

title: Psalms 77:20
text: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron. A contemplation by Asaph.

title: Psalms 78
inscription: Maschil of Asaph.

title: Psalms 78:1
text: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

title: Psalms 78:2
text: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

title: Psalms 78:3
text: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

title: Psalms 78:4
text: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and his wondrous works that he has done.

title: Psalms 78:5
text: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

title: Psalms 78:6
text: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

title: Psalms 78:7
text: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments,

title: Psalms 78:8
text: and might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn't make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

title: Psalms 78:9
text: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

title: Psalms 78:10
text: They didn't keep God's covenant, and refused to walk in his law.

title: Psalms 78:11
text: They forgot his doings, his wondrous works that he had shown them.

title: Psalms 78:12
text: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

title: Psalms 78:13
text: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.

title: Psalms 78:14
text: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

title: Psalms 78:15
text: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

title: Psalms 78:16
text: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

title: Psalms 78:17
text: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

title: Psalms 78:18
text: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

title: Psalms 78:19
text: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, "Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

title: Psalms 78:20
text: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide flesh for his people?"

title: Psalms 78:21
text: Therefore Yahweh heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,

title: Psalms 78:22
text: because they didn't believe in God, and didn't trust in his salvation.

title: Psalms 78:23
text: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.

title: Psalms 78:24
text: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.

title: Psalms 78:25
text: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.

title: Psalms 78:26
text: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.

title: Psalms 78:27
text: He rained also flesh on them as the dust; winged birds as the sand of the seas.

title: Psalms 78:28
text: He let them fall in the midst of their camp, around their habitations.

title: Psalms 78:29
text: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.

title: Psalms 78:30
text: They didn't turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,

title: Psalms 78:31
text: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of the fattest of them, and struck down the young men of Israel.

title: Psalms 78:32
text: For all this they still sinned, and didn't believe in his wondrous works.

title: Psalms 78:33
text: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

title: Psalms 78:34
text: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

title: Psalms 78:35
text: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

title: Psalms 78:36
text: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

title: Psalms 78:37
text: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

title: Psalms 78:38
text: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn't destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn't stir up all his wrath.

title: Psalms 78:39
text: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn't come again.

title: Psalms 78:40
text: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

title: Psalms 78:41
text: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

title: Psalms 78:42
text: They didn't remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

title: Psalms 78:43
text: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,

title: Psalms 78:44
text: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.

title: Psalms 78:45
text: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

title: Psalms 78:46
text: He gave also their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.

title: Psalms 78:47
text: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.

title: Psalms 78:48
text: He gave over their livestock also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

title: Psalms 78:49
text: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.

title: Psalms 78:50
text: He made a path for his anger. He didn't spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

title: Psalms 78:51
text: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

title: Psalms 78:52
text: But he led forth his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

title: Psalms 78:53
text: He led them safely, so that they weren't afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

title: Psalms 78:54
text: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

title: Psalms 78:55
text: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

title: Psalms 78:56
text: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn't keep his testimonies;

title: Psalms 78:57
text: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

title: Psalms 78:58
text: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

title: Psalms 78:59
text: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel;

title: Psalms 78:60
text: So that he forsook the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;

title: Psalms 78:61
text: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary's hand.

title: Psalms 78:62
text: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

title: Psalms 78:63
text: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.

title: Psalms 78:64
text: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn't weep.

title: Psalms 78:65
text: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

title: Psalms 78:66
text: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.

title: Psalms 78:67
text: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn't choose the tribe of Ephraim,

title: Psalms 78:68
text: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

title: Psalms 78:69
text: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

title: Psalms 78:70
text: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

title: Psalms 78:71
text: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.

title: Psalms 78:72
text: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands. A Psalm by Asaph.

title: Psalms 79
inscription: A Psalm of Asaph.

title: Psalms 79:1
text: God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

title: Psalms 79:2
text: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

title: Psalms 79:3
text: Their blood they have shed like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.

title: Psalms 79:4
text: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.

title: Psalms 79:5
text: How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

title: Psalms 79:6
text: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don't know you; on the kingdoms that don't call on your name;

title: Psalms 79:7
text: For they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.

title: Psalms 79:8
text: Don't hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.

title: Psalms 79:9
text: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name's sake.

title: Psalms 79:10
text: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants' blood is being poured out.

title: Psalms 79:11
text: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

title: Psalms 79:12
text: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

title: Psalms 79:13
text: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "The Lilies of the Covenant." A Psalm by Asaph.

title: Psalms 80
inscription: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannimeduth, A Psalm of Asaph.

title: Psalms 80:1
text: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine forth.

title: Psalms 80:2
text: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!

title: Psalms 80:3
text: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

title: Psalms 80:4
text: Yahweh God of Armies, How long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

title: Psalms 80:5
text: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

title: Psalms 80:6
text: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

title: Psalms 80:7
text: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

title: Psalms 80:8
text: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

title: Psalms 80:9
text: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.

title: Psalms 80:10
text: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God's cedars.

title: Psalms 80:11
text: It sent out its branches to the sea, Its shoots to the River.

title: Psalms 80:12
text: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

title: Psalms 80:13
text: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.

title: Psalms 80:14
text: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

title: Psalms 80:15
text: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

title: Psalms 80:16
text: It's burned with fire. It's cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

title: Psalms 80:17
text: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

title: Psalms 80:18
text: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

title: Psalms 80:19
text: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved. For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. By Asaph.

title: Psalms 81
inscription: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of Asaph.

title: Psalms 81:1
text: Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

title: Psalms 81:2
text: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.

title: Psalms 81:3
text: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.

title: Psalms 81:4
text: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

title: Psalms 81:5
text: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn't know.

title: Psalms 81:6
text: "I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.

title: Psalms 81:7
text: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah." Selah.

title: Psalms 81:8
text: "Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!

title: Psalms 81:9
text: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.

title: Psalms 81:10
text: I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

title: Psalms 81:11
text: But my people didn't listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

title: Psalms 81:12
text: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

title: Psalms 81:13
text: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

title: Psalms 81:14
text: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

title: Psalms 81:15
text: The haters of Yahweh would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

title: Psalms 81:16
text: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock." A Psalm by Asaph.

title: Psalms 82
inscription: A Psalm of Asaph.

title: Psalms 82:1
text: God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.

title: Psalms 82:2
text: "How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?" Selah.

title: Psalms 82:3
text: "Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

title: Psalms 82:4
text: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked."

title: Psalms 82:5
text: They don't know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

title: Psalms 82:6
text: I said, "You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.

title: Psalms 82:7
text: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers."

title: Psalms 82:8
text: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations. A song. A Psalm by Asaph.

title: Psalms 83
inscription: A Song [or] Psalm of Asaph.

title: Psalms 83:1
text: God, don't keep silent. Don't keep silent, and don't be still, God.

title: Psalms 83:2
text: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

title: Psalms 83:3
text: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

title: Psalms 83:4
text: "Come," they say, "and let's destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more."

title: Psalms 83:5
text: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

title: Psalms 83:6
text: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

title: Psalms 83:7
text: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

title: Psalms 83:8
text: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.

title: Psalms 83:9
text: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

title: Psalms 83:10
text: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

title: Psalms 83:11
text: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb; yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna;

title: Psalms 83:12
text: who said, "Let us take possession of God's pasturelands."

title: Psalms 83:13
text: My God, make them like tumbleweed; like chaff before the wind.

title: Psalms 83:14
text: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

title: Psalms 83:15
text: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

title: Psalms 83:16
text: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Yahweh.

title: Psalms 83:17
text: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

title: Psalms 83:18
text: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth. For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.

title: Psalms 84
inscription: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.

title: Psalms 84:1
text: How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!

title: Psalms 84:2
text: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

title: Psalms 84:3
text: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, Yahweh of Armies, my King, and my God.

title: Psalms 84:4
text: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

title: Psalms 84:5
text: Blessed are those whose strength is in you; who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

title: Psalms 84:6
text: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

title: Psalms 84:7
text: They go from strength to strength. Everyone of them appears before God in Zion.

title: Psalms 84:8
text: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

title: Psalms 84:9
text: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

title: Psalms 84:10
text: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

title: Psalms 84:11
text: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

title: Psalms 84:12
text: Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you. For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.

title: Psalms 85
inscription: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.

title: Psalms 85:1
text: Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

title: Psalms 85:2
text: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

title: Psalms 85:3
text: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

title: Psalms 85:4
text: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

title: Psalms 85:5
text: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

title: Psalms 85:6
text: Won't you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

title: Psalms 85:7
text: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.

title: Psalms 85:8
text: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

title: Psalms 85:9
text: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

title: Psalms 85:10
text: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

title: Psalms 85:11
text: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

title: Psalms 85:12
text: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

title: Psalms 85:13
text: Righteousness goes before him, And prepares the way for his steps. A Prayer by David.

title: Psalms 86
inscription: A Prayer of David.

title: Psalms 86:1
text: Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

title: Psalms 86:2
text: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

title: Psalms 86:3
text: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

title: Psalms 86:4
text: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

title: Psalms 86:5
text: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive; abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

title: Psalms 86:6
text: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

title: Psalms 86:7
text: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

title: Psalms 86:8
text: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.

title: Psalms 86:9
text: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

title: Psalms 86:10
text: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

title: Psalms 86:11
text: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

title: Psalms 86:12
text: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forevermore.

title: Psalms 86:13
text: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

title: Psalms 86:14
text: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don't hold regard for you before them.

title: Psalms 86:15
text: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

title: Psalms 86:16
text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your handmaid.

title: Psalms 86:17
text: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me, and comforted me. A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song.

title: Psalms 87
inscription: A Psalm [or] Song for the sons of Korah.

title: Psalms 87:1
text: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

title: Psalms 87:2
text: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

title: Psalms 87:3
text: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.

title: Psalms 87:4
text: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: "This one was born there."

title: Psalms 87:5
text: Yes, of Zion it will be said, "This one and that one was born in her;" the Most High himself will establish her.

title: Psalms 87:6
text: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, "This one was born there." Selah.

title: Psalms 87:7
text: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, "All my springs are in you." A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "The Suffering of Affliction." A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite.

title: Psalms 88
inscription: A Song [or] Psalm for the sons of Korah, to the chief Musician upon Mahalath Leannoth, Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.

title: Psalms 88:1
text: Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

title: Psalms 88:2
text: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

title: Psalms 88:3
text: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.

title: Psalms 88:4
text: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

title: Psalms 88:5
text: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

title: Psalms 88:6
text: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

title: Psalms 88:7
text: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

title: Psalms 88:8
text: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can't escape.

title: Psalms 88:9
text: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.

title: Psalms 88:10
text: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the dead rise up and praise you? Selah.

title: Psalms 88:11
text: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

title: Psalms 88:12
text: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

title: Psalms 88:13
text: But to you, Yahweh, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

title: Psalms 88:14
text: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

title: Psalms 88:15
text: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

title: Psalms 88:16
text: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

title: Psalms 88:17
text: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

title: Psalms 88:18
text: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness. A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite.

title: Psalms 89
inscription: Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.

title: Psalms 89:1
text: I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

title: Psalms 89:2
text: I indeed declare, "Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them."

title: Psalms 89:3
text: "I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

title: Psalms 89:4
text: 'I will establish your seed forever, and build up your throne to all generations.'" Selah.

title: Psalms 89:5
text: The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh; your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

title: Psalms 89:6
text: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,

title: Psalms 89:7
text: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

title: Psalms 89:8
text: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.

title: Psalms 89:9
text: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

title: Psalms 89:10
text: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

title: Psalms 89:11
text: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours; the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

title: Psalms 89:12
text: The north and the south, you have created them. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

title: Psalms 89:13
text: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

title: Psalms 89:14
text: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

title: Psalms 89:15
text: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.

title: Psalms 89:16
text: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

title: Psalms 89:17
text: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

title: Psalms 89:18
text: For our shield belongs to Yahweh; our king to the Holy One of Israel.

title: Psalms 89:19
text: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, "I have bestowed strength on the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

title: Psalms 89:20
text: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

title: Psalms 89:21
text: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

title: Psalms 89:22
text: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

title: Psalms 89:23
text: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

title: Psalms 89:24
text: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

title: Psalms 89:25
text: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

title: Psalms 89:26
text: He will call to me, 'You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!'

title: Psalms 89:27
text: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

title: Psalms 89:28
text: I will keep my loving kindness for him forevermore. My covenant will stand firm with him.

title: Psalms 89:29
text: I will also make his seed endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

title: Psalms 89:30
text: If his children forsake my law, and don't walk in my ordinances;

title: Psalms 89:31
text: if they break my statutes, and don't keep my commandments;

title: Psalms 89:32
text: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

title: Psalms 89:33
text: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

title: Psalms 89:34
text: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

title: Psalms 89:35
text: Once have I sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

title: Psalms 89:36
text: His seed will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

title: Psalms 89:37
text: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky." Selah.

title: Psalms 89:38
text: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

title: Psalms 89:39
text: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

title: Psalms 89:40
text: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

title: Psalms 89:41
text: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

title: Psalms 89:42
text: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

title: Psalms 89:43
text: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven't supported him in battle.

title: Psalms 89:44
text: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

title: Psalms 89:45
text: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

title: Psalms 89:46
text: How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

title: Psalms 89:47
text: Remember how short my time is! For what vanity have you created all the children of men!

title: Psalms 89:48
text: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

title: Psalms 89:49
text: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

title: Psalms 89:50
text: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

title: Psalms 89:51
text: With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

title: Psalms 89:52
text: Blessed be Yahweh forevermore. Amen, and Amen. BOOK IV A Prayer by Moses, the man of God.

title: Psalms 90
inscription: A Prayer of Moses the man of God.

title: Psalms 90:1
text: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

title: Psalms 90:2
text: Before the mountains were brought forth, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

title: Psalms 90:3
text: You turn man to destruction, saying, "Return, you children of men."

title: Psalms 90:4
text: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
