title: Psalms 90:5
text: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

title: Psalms 90:6
text: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

title: Psalms 90:7
text: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

title: Psalms 90:8
text: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

title: Psalms 90:9
text: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

title: Psalms 90:10
text: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

title: Psalms 90:11
text: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

title: Psalms 90:12
text: So teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

title: Psalms 90:13
text: Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

title: Psalms 90:14
text: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

title: Psalms 90:15
text: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

title: Psalms 90:16
text: Let your work appear to your servants; your glory to their children.

title: Psalms 90:17
text: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us; establish the work of our hands for us; yes, establish the work of our hands.

title: Psalms 91:1
text: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

title: Psalms 91:2
text: I will say of Yahweh, "He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust."

title: Psalms 91:3
text: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.

title: Psalms 91:4
text: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

title: Psalms 91:5
text: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day;

title: Psalms 91:6
text: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

title: Psalms 91:7
text: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

title: Psalms 91:8
text: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.

title: Psalms 91:9
text: Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

title: Psalms 91:10
text: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

title: Psalms 91:11
text: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

title: Psalms 91:12
text: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won't dash your foot against a stone.

title: Psalms 91:13
text: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

title: Psalms 91:14
text: "Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

title: Psalms 91:15
text: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

title: Psalms 91:16
text: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation." A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day.

title: Psalms 92
inscription: A Psalm [or] Song for the sabbath day.

title: Psalms 92:1
text: It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High;

title: Psalms 92:2
text: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

title: Psalms 92:3
text: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.

title: Psalms 92:4
text: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.

title: Psalms 92:5
text: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.

title: Psalms 92:6
text: A senseless man doesn't know, neither does a fool understand this:

title: Psalms 92:7
text: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

title: Psalms 92:8
text: But you, Yahweh, are on high forevermore.

title: Psalms 92:9
text: For, behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for, behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.

title: Psalms 92:10
text: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.

title: Psalms 92:11
text: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.

title: Psalms 92:12
text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

title: Psalms 92:13
text: They are planted in Yahweh's house. They will flourish in our God's courts.

title: Psalms 92:14
text: They will still bring forth fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

title: Psalms 92:15
text: to show that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

title: Psalms 93:1
text: Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can't be moved.

title: Psalms 93:2
text: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.

title: Psalms 93:3
text: The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

title: Psalms 93:4
text: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.

title: Psalms 93:5
text: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Yahweh, forevermore.

title: Psalms 94:1
text: Yahweh, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine forth.

title: Psalms 94:2
text: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

title: Psalms 94:3
text: Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?

title: Psalms 94:4
text: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

title: Psalms 94:5
text: They break your people in pieces, Yahweh, and afflict your heritage.

title: Psalms 94:6
text: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

title: Psalms 94:7
text: They say, "Yah will not see, neither will Jacob's God consider."

title: Psalms 94:8
text: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?

title: Psalms 94:9
text: He who implanted the ear, won't he hear? He who formed the eye, won't he see?

title: Psalms 94:10
text: He who disciplines the nations, won't he punish? He who teaches man knows.

title: Psalms 94:11
text: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

title: Psalms 94:12
text: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law;

title: Psalms 94:13
text: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

title: Psalms 94:14
text: For Yahweh won't reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

title: Psalms 94:15
text: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

title: Psalms 94:16
text: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

title: Psalms 94:17
text: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

title: Psalms 94:18
text: When I said, "My foot is slipping!" Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.

title: Psalms 94:19
text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

title: Psalms 94:20
text: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

title: Psalms 94:21
text: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

title: Psalms 94:22
text: But Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.

title: Psalms 94:23
text: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. Yahweh, our God, will cut them off.

title: Psalms 95:1
text: Oh come, let's sing to Yahweh. Let's shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

title: Psalms 95:2
text: Let's come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let's extol him with songs!

title: Psalms 95:3
text: For Yahweh is a great God, a great King above all gods.

title: Psalms 95:4
text: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

title: Psalms 95:5
text: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

title: Psalms 95:6
text: Oh come, let's worship and bow down. Let's kneel before Yahweh, our Maker,

title: Psalms 95:7
text: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!

title: Psalms 95:8
text: Don't harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

title: Psalms 95:9
text: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.

title: Psalms 95:10
text: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, "It is a people that errs in their heart. They have not known my ways."

title: Psalms 95:11
text: Therefore I swore in my wrath, "They won't enter into my rest."

title: Psalms 96:1
text: Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.

title: Psalms 96:2
text: Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!

title: Psalms 96:3
text: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.

title: Psalms 96:4
text: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.

title: Psalms 96:5
text: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.

title: Psalms 96:6
text: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

title: Psalms 96:7
text: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

title: Psalms 96:8
text: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

title: Psalms 96:9
text: Worship Yahweh in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.

title: Psalms 96:10
text: Say among the nations, "Yahweh reigns." The world is also established. It can't be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.

title: Psalms 96:11
text: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

title: Psalms 96:12
text: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy

title: Psalms 96:13
text: before Yahweh; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.

title: Psalms 97:1
text: Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!

title: Psalms 97:2
text: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

title: Psalms 97:3
text: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.

title: Psalms 97:4
text: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.

title: Psalms 97:5
text: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

title: Psalms 97:6
text: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.

title: Psalms 97:7
text: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!

title: Psalms 97:8
text: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced, because of your judgments, Yahweh.

title: Psalms 97:9
text: For you, Yahweh, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.

title: Psalms 97:10
text: You who love Yahweh, hate evil. He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

title: Psalms 97:11
text: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

title: Psalms 97:12
text: Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name. A Psalm.

title: Psalms 98
inscription: A Psalm.

title: Psalms 98:1
text: Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand, and his holy arm, have worked salvation for him.

title: Psalms 98:2
text: Yahweh has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

title: Psalms 98:3
text: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

title: Psalms 98:4
text: Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

title: Psalms 98:5
text: Sing praises to Yahweh with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.

title: Psalms 98:6
text: With trumpets and sound of the ram's horn, make a joyful noise before the King, Yahweh.

title: Psalms 98:7
text: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

title: Psalms 98:8
text: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.

title: Psalms 98:9
text: Let them sing before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.

title: Psalms 99:1
text: Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.

title: Psalms 99:2
text: Yahweh is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.

title: Psalms 99:3
text: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

title: Psalms 99:4
text: The King's strength also loves justice. You do establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.

title: Psalms 99:5
text: Exalt Yahweh our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!

title: Psalms 99:6
text: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel among those who call on his name; they called on Yahweh, and he answered them.

title: Psalms 99:7
text: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.

title: Psalms 99:8
text: You answered them, Yahweh our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

title: Psalms 99:9
text: Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy! A Psalm of thanksgiving.

title: Psalms 100
inscription: A Psalm of praise.

title: Psalms 100:1
text: Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!

title: Psalms 100:2
text: Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

title: Psalms 100:3
text: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

title: Psalms 100:4
text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

title: Psalms 100:5
text: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations. A Psalm by David.

title: Psalms 101
inscription: A Psalm of David.

title: Psalms 101:1
text: I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.

title: Psalms 101:2
text: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

title: Psalms 101:3
text: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.

title: Psalms 101:4
text: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

title: Psalms 101:5
text: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won't tolerate one who is haughty and conceited.

title: Psalms 101:6
text: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

title: Psalms 101:7
text: He who practices deceit won't dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won't be established before my eyes.

title: Psalms 101:8
text: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land; to cut off all the workers of iniquity from Yahweh's city. A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before Yahweh.

title: Psalms 102
inscription: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before the LORD.

title: Psalms 102:1
text: Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.

title: Psalms 102:2
text: Don't hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

title: Psalms 102:3
text: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.

title: Psalms 102:4
text: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

title: Psalms 102:5
text: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.

title: Psalms 102:6
text: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.

title: Psalms 102:7
text: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

title: Psalms 102:8
text: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

title: Psalms 102:9
text: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,

title: Psalms 102:10
text: Because of your indignation and your wrath, for you have taken me up, and thrown me away.

title: Psalms 102:11
text: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.

title: Psalms 102:12
text: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.

title: Psalms 102:13
text: You will arise and have mercy on Zion; for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.

title: Psalms 102:14
text: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

title: Psalms 102:15
text: So the nations will fear the name of Yahweh; all the kings of the earth your glory.

title: Psalms 102:16
text: For Yahweh has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.

title: Psalms 102:17
text: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

title: Psalms 102:18
text: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise Yah.

title: Psalms 102:19
text: For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth;

title: Psalms 102:20
text: to hear the groans of the prisoner; to free those who are condemned to death;

title: Psalms 102:21
text: that men may declare the name of Yahweh in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

title: Psalms 102:22
text: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.

title: Psalms 102:23
text: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.

title: Psalms 102:24
text: I said, "My God, don't take me away in the midst of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.

title: Psalms 102:25
text: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.

title: Psalms 102:26
text: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.

title: Psalms 102:27
text: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.

title: Psalms 102:28
text: The children of your servants will continue. Their seed will be established before you." By David.

title: Psalms 103
inscription: [A Psalm] of David.

title: Psalms 103:1
text: Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

title: Psalms 103:2
text: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don't forget all his benefits;

title: Psalms 103:3
text: who forgives all your sins; who heals all your diseases;

title: Psalms 103:4
text: who redeems your life from destruction; who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies;

title: Psalms 103:5
text: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's.

title: Psalms 103:6
text: Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

title: Psalms 103:7
text: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.

title: Psalms 103:8
text: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

title: Psalms 103:9
text: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.

title: Psalms 103:10
text: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

title: Psalms 103:11
text: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

title: Psalms 103:12
text: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

title: Psalms 103:13
text: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.

title: Psalms 103:14
text: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

title: Psalms 103:15
text: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

title: Psalms 103:16
text: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

title: Psalms 103:17
text: But Yahweh's loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children's children;

title: Psalms 103:18
text: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

title: Psalms 103:19
text: Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.

title: Psalms 103:20
text: Praise Yahweh, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.

title: Psalms 103:21
text: Praise Yahweh, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

title: Psalms 103:22
text: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!

title: Psalms 104:1
text: Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

title: Psalms 104:2
text: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

title: Psalms 104:3
text: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

title: Psalms 104:4
text: He makes his messengers winds; his servants flames of fire.

title: Psalms 104:5
text: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

title: Psalms 104:6
text: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

title: Psalms 104:7
text: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

title: Psalms 104:8
text: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

title: Psalms 104:9
text: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over; that they don't turn again to cover the earth.

title: Psalms 104:10
text: He sends forth springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.

title: Psalms 104:11
text: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

title: Psalms 104:12
text: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.

title: Psalms 104:13
text: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

title: Psalms 104:14
text: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may bring forth food out of the earth:

title: Psalms 104:15
text: wine that makes glad the heart of man, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man's heart.

title: Psalms 104:16
text: Yahweh's trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;

title: Psalms 104:17
text: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the fir trees.

title: Psalms 104:18
text: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

title: Psalms 104:19
text: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.

title: Psalms 104:20
text: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

title: Psalms 104:21
text: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

title: Psalms 104:22
text: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lay down in their dens.

title: Psalms 104:23
text: Man goes forth to his work, to his labor until the evening.

title: Psalms 104:24
text: Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom have you made them all. The earth is full of your riches.

title: Psalms 104:25
text: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.

title: Psalms 104:26
text: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

title: Psalms 104:27
text: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

title: Psalms 104:28
text: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

title: Psalms 104:29
text: You hide your face: they are troubled; you take away their breath: they die, and return to the dust.

title: Psalms 104:30
text: You send forth your Spirit: they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

title: Psalms 104:31
text: Let the glory of Yahweh endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.

title: Psalms 104:32
text: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

title: Psalms 104:33
text: I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

title: Psalms 104:34
text: Let your meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.

title: Psalms 104:35
text: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!

title: Psalms 105:1
text: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

title: Psalms 105:2
text: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

title: Psalms 105:3
text: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.

title: Psalms 105:4
text: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

title: Psalms 105:5
text: Remember his marvelous works that he has done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

title: Psalms 105:6
text: you seed of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

title: Psalms 105:7
text: He is Yahweh, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

title: Psalms 105:8
text: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

title: Psalms 105:9
text: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

title: Psalms 105:10
text: and confirmed the same to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

title: Psalms 105:11
text: saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;"

title: Psalms 105:12
text: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

title: Psalms 105:13
text: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

title: Psalms 105:14
text: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

title: Psalms 105:15
text: "Don't touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!"

title: Psalms 105:16
text: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

title: Psalms 105:17
text: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

title: Psalms 105:18
text: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

title: Psalms 105:19
text: until the time that his word happened, and Yahweh's word proved him true.

title: Psalms 105:20
text: The king sent and freed him; even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

title: Psalms 105:21
text: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions;

title: Psalms 105:22
text: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

title: Psalms 105:23
text: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

title: Psalms 105:24
text: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

title: Psalms 105:25
text: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

title: Psalms 105:26
text: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

title: Psalms 105:27
text: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

title: Psalms 105:28
text: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn't rebel against his words.

title: Psalms 105:29
text: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

title: Psalms 105:30
text: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.

title: Psalms 105:31
text: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

title: Psalms 105:32
text: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

title: Psalms 105:33
text: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

title: Psalms 105:34
text: He spoke, and the locusts came, and the grasshoppers, without number,

title: Psalms 105:35
text: ate up every plant in their land; and ate up the fruit of their ground.

title: Psalms 105:36
text: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

title: Psalms 105:37
text: He brought them forth with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

title: Psalms 105:38
text: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

title: Psalms 105:39
text: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

title: Psalms 105:40
text: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

title: Psalms 105:41
text: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

title: Psalms 105:42
text: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

title: Psalms 105:43
text: He brought forth his people with joy, his chosen with singing.

title: Psalms 105:44
text: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

title: Psalms 105:45
text: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!

title: Psalms 106:1
text: Praise Yahweh! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

title: Psalms 106:2
text: Who can utter the mighty acts of Yahweh, or fully declare all his praise?

title: Psalms 106:3
text: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.

title: Psalms 106:4
text: Remember me, Yahweh, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,

title: Psalms 106:5
text: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.

title: Psalms 106:6
text: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.

title: Psalms 106:7
text: Our fathers didn't understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn't remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

title: Psalms 106:8
text: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power known.

title: Psalms 106:9
text: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.

title: Psalms 106:10
text: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

title: Psalms 106:11
text: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.

title: Psalms 106:12
text: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.

title: Psalms 106:13
text: They soon forgot his works. They didn't wait for his counsel,

title: Psalms 106:14
text: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.

title: Psalms 106:15
text: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

title: Psalms 106:16
text: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, Yahweh's saint.

title: Psalms 106:17
text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

title: Psalms 106:18
text: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.

title: Psalms 106:19
text: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.

title: Psalms 106:20
text: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.

title: Psalms 106:21
text: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,

title: Psalms 106:22
text: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.

title: Psalms 106:23
text: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn't destroy them.

title: Psalms 106:24
text: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn't believe his word,

title: Psalms 106:25
text: but murmured in their tents, and didn't listen to Yahweh's voice.

title: Psalms 106:26
text: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,

title: Psalms 106:27
text: that he would overthrow their seed among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.

title: Psalms 106:28
text: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

title: Psalms 106:29
text: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.

title: Psalms 106:30
text: Then Phinehas stood up, and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.

title: Psalms 106:31
text: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.

title: Psalms 106:32
text: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;

title: Psalms 106:33
text: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.

title: Psalms 106:34
text: They didn't destroy the peoples, as Yahweh commanded them,

title: Psalms 106:35
text: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.

title: Psalms 106:36
text: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.

title: Psalms 106:37
text: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

title: Psalms 106:38
text: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.

title: Psalms 106:39
text: Thus were they defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.

title: Psalms 106:40
text: Therefore Yahweh burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.

title: Psalms 106:41
text: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.

title: Psalms 106:42
text: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.

title: Psalms 106:43
text: Many times he delivered them, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.

title: Psalms 106:44
text: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.

title: Psalms 106:45
text: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

title: Psalms 106:46
text: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.

title: Psalms 106:47
text: Save us, Yahweh, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!

title: Psalms 106:48
text: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, "Amen." Praise Yah! BOOK V

title: Psalms 107:1
text: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

title: Psalms 107:2
text: Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

title: Psalms 107:3
text: And gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

title: Psalms 107:4
text: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

title: Psalms 107:5
text: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

title: Psalms 107:6
text: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses,

title: Psalms 107:7
text: he led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

title: Psalms 107:8
text: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!

title: Psalms 107:9
text: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

title: Psalms 107:10
text: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,

title: Psalms 107:11
text: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

title: Psalms 107:12
text: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was none to help.

title: Psalms 107:13
text: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

title: Psalms 107:14
text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke their bonds in sunder.

title: Psalms 107:15
text: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!

title: Psalms 107:16
text: For he has broken the gates of brass, and cut through bars of iron.

title: Psalms 107:17
text: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

title: Psalms 107:18
text: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

title: Psalms 107:19
text: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, he saves them out of their distresses.

title: Psalms 107:20
text: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

title: Psalms 107:21
text: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!

title: Psalms 107:22
text: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with singing.

title: Psalms 107:23
text: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters;

title: Psalms 107:24
text: These see Yahweh's works, and his wonders in the deep.

title: Psalms 107:25
text: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

title: Psalms 107:26
text: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

title: Psalms 107:27
text: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits' end.

title: Psalms 107:28
text: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

title: Psalms 107:29
text: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

title: Psalms 107:30
text: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

title: Psalms 107:31
text: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works for the children of men!

title: Psalms 107:32
text: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

title: Psalms 107:33
text: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

title: Psalms 107:34
text: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

title: Psalms 107:35
text: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

title: Psalms 107:36
text: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

title: Psalms 107:37
text: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

title: Psalms 107:38
text: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn't allow their livestock to decrease.

title: Psalms 107:39
text: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

title: Psalms 107:40
text: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

title: Psalms 107:41
text: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

title: Psalms 107:42
text: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.

title: Psalms 107:43
text: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh. A Song. A Psalm by David.

title: Psalms 108
inscription: A Song [or] Psalm of David.

title: Psalms 108:1
text: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

title: Psalms 108:2
text: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

title: Psalms 108:3
text: I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

title: Psalms 108:4
text: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

title: Psalms 108:5
text: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

title: Psalms 108:6
text: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

title: Psalms 108:7
text: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

title: Psalms 108:8
text: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

title: Psalms 108:9
text: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia."

title: Psalms 108:10
text: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who has led me to Edom?

title: Psalms 108:11
text: Haven't you rejected us, God? You don't go forth, God, with our armies.

title: Psalms 108:12
text: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

title: Psalms 108:13
text: Through God, we will do valiantly. For it is he who will tread down our enemies. For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

title: Psalms 109
inscription: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

title: Psalms 109:1
text: God of my praise, don't remain silent,

title: Psalms 109:2
text: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

title: Psalms 109:3
text: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

title: Psalms 109:4
text: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

title: Psalms 109:5
text: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

title: Psalms 109:6
text: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

title: Psalms 109:7
text: When he is judged, let him come forth guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

title: Psalms 109:8
text: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

title: Psalms 109:9
text: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

title: Psalms 109:10
text: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.

title: Psalms 109:11
text: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

title: Psalms 109:12
text: Let there be none to extend kindness to him, neither let there be any to have pity on his fatherless children.

title: Psalms 109:13
text: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

title: Psalms 109:14
text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh. Don't let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

title: Psalms 109:15
text: Let them be before Yahweh continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth;

title: Psalms 109:16
text: because he didn't remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

title: Psalms 109:17
text: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn't delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

title: Psalms 109:18
text: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

title: Psalms 109:19
text: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

title: Psalms 109:20
text: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh, of those who speak evil against my soul.

title: Psalms 109:21
text: But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name's sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

title: Psalms 109:22
text: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

title: Psalms 109:23
text: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

title: Psalms 109:24
text: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

title: Psalms 109:25
text: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

title: Psalms 109:26
text: Help me, Yahweh, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

title: Psalms 109:27
text: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahweh, have done it.

title: Psalms 109:28
text: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

title: Psalms 109:29
text: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

title: Psalms 109:30
text: I will give great thanks to Yahweh with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

title: Psalms 109:31
text: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul. A Psalm by David.

title: Psalms 110
inscription: A Psalm of David.

title: Psalms 110:1
text: Yahweh says to my Lord, "Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet."

title: Psalms 110:2
text: Yahweh will send forth the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule in the midst of your enemies.

title: Psalms 110:3
text: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

title: Psalms 110:4
text: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: "You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek."

title: Psalms 110:5
text: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

title: Psalms 110:6
text: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

title: Psalms 110:7
text: He will drink of the brook in the way; therefore he will lift up his head.

title: Psalms 111:1
text: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

title: Psalms 111:2
text: Yahweh's works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

title: Psalms 111:3
text: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

title: Psalms 111:4
text: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.

title: Psalms 111:5
text: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

title: Psalms 111:6
text: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

title: Psalms 111:7
text: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

title: Psalms 111:8
text: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.

title: Psalms 111:9
text: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

title: Psalms 111:10
text: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

title: Psalms 112:1
text: Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.

title: Psalms 112:2
text: His seed will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.

title: Psalms 112:3
text: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

title: Psalms 112:4
text: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

title: Psalms 112:5
text: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.

title: Psalms 112:6
text: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.

title: Psalms 112:7
text: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.

title: Psalms 112:8
text: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

title: Psalms 112:9
text: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.

title: Psalms 112:10
text: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

title: Psalms 113:1
text: Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise the name of Yahweh.

title: Psalms 113:2
text: Blessed be the name of Yahweh, from this time forth and forevermore.

title: Psalms 113:3
text: From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same, Yahweh's name is to be praised.

title: Psalms 113:4
text: Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

title: Psalms 113:5
text: Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,

title: Psalms 113:6
text: Who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?

title: Psalms 113:7
text: He raises up the poor out of the dust. Lifts up the needy from the ash heap;

title: Psalms 113:8
text: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

title: Psalms 113:9
text: He settles the barren woman in her home, as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!

title: Psalms 114:1
text: When Israel went forth out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language;

title: Psalms 114:2
text: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

title: Psalms 114:3
text: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.

title: Psalms 114:4
text: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.

title: Psalms 114:5
text: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?

title: Psalms 114:6
text: You mountains, that you skipped like rams; you little hills, like lambs?

title: Psalms 114:7
text: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

title: Psalms 114:8
text: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.

title: Psalms 115:1
text: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth's sake.

title: Psalms 115:2
text: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God, now?"

title: Psalms 115:3
text: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.

title: Psalms 115:4
text: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

title: Psalms 115:5
text: They have mouths, but they don't speak. They have eyes, but they don't see.

title: Psalms 115:6
text: They have ears, but they don't hear. They have noses, but they don't smell.

title: Psalms 115:7
text: They have hands, but they don't feel. They have feet, but they don't walk, neither do they speak through their throat.

title: Psalms 115:8
text: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

title: Psalms 115:9
text: Israel, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

title: Psalms 115:10
text: House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

title: Psalms 115:11
text: You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

title: Psalms 115:12
text: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

title: Psalms 115:13
text: He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.

title: Psalms 115:14
text: May Yahweh increase you more and more, you and your children.

title: Psalms 115:15
text: Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

title: Psalms 115:16
text: The heavens are the heavens of Yahweh; but the earth has he given to the children of men.

title: Psalms 115:17
text: The dead don't praise Yah, neither any who go down into silence;

title: Psalms 115:18
text: But we will bless Yah, from this time forth and forevermore. Praise Yah!

title: Psalms 116:1
text: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

title: Psalms 116:2
text: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

title: Psalms 116:3
text: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

title: Psalms 116:4
text: Then I called on the name of Yahweh: "Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul."

title: Psalms 116:5
text: Yahweh is Gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

title: Psalms 116:6
text: Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

title: Psalms 116:7
text: Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.

title: Psalms 116:8
text: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

title: Psalms 116:9
text: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.

title: Psalms 116:10
text: I believed, therefore I said, "I was greatly afflicted."

title: Psalms 116:11
text: I said in my haste, "All men are liars."

title: Psalms 116:12
text: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?

title: Psalms 116:13
text: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the name of Yahweh.

title: Psalms 116:14
text: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.

title: Psalms 116:15
text: Precious in the sight of Yahweh is the death of his saints.

title: Psalms 116:16
text: Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your handmaid. You have freed me from my chains.

title: Psalms 116:17
text: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the name of Yahweh.

title: Psalms 116:18
text: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people,

title: Psalms 116:19
text: in the courts of Yahweh's house, in the midst of you, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!

title: Psalms 117:1
text: Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

title: Psalms 117:2
text: For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh's faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!

title: Psalms 118:1
text: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

title: Psalms 118:2
text: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

title: Psalms 118:3
text: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

title: Psalms 118:4
text: Now let those who fear Yahweh say that his loving kindness endures forever.

title: Psalms 118:5
text: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.

title: Psalms 118:6
text: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

title: Psalms 118:7
text: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

title: Psalms 118:8
text: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.

title: Psalms 118:9
text: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.

title: Psalms 118:10
text: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of Yahweh, I cut them off.

title: Psalms 118:11
text: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the name of Yahweh I indeed cut them off.

title: Psalms 118:12
text: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the name of Yahweh I cut them off.

title: Psalms 118:13
text: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.

title: Psalms 118:14
text: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.

title: Psalms 118:15
text: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. "The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.

title: Psalms 118:16
text: The right hand of Yahweh is exalted! The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!"

title: Psalms 118:17
text: I will not die, but live, and declare Yah's works.

title: Psalms 118:18
text: Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

title: Psalms 118:19
text: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.

title: Psalms 118:20
text: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.

title: Psalms 118:21
text: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

title: Psalms 118:22
text: The stone which the builders rejected has become the head of the corner.

title: Psalms 118:23
text: This is Yahweh's doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.

title: Psalms 118:24
text: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

title: Psalms 118:25
text: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.

title: Psalms 118:26
text: Blessed is he who comes in the name of Yahweh! We have blessed you out of the house of Yahweh.

title: Psalms 118:27
text: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

title: Psalms 118:28
text: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.

title: Psalms 118:29
text: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever. ALEPH

title: Psalms 119:1
text: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh's law.

title: Psalms 119:2
text: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.

title: Psalms 119:3
text: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

title: Psalms 119:4
text: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

title: Psalms 119:5
text: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!

title: Psalms 119:6
text: Then I wouldn't be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:7
text: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

title: Psalms 119:8
text: I will observe your statutes. Don't utterly forsake me

title: Psalms 119:9
text: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

title: Psalms 119:10
text: With my whole heart, I have sought you. Don't let me wander from your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:11
text: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

title: Psalms 119:12
text: Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:13
text: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

title: Psalms 119:14
text: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

title: Psalms 119:15
text: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

title: Psalms 119:16
text: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word

title: Psalms 119:17
text: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

title: Psalms 119:18
text: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

title: Psalms 119:19
text: I am a stranger on the earth. Don't hide your commandments from me.

title: Psalms 119:20
text: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.

title: Psalms 119:21
text: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:22
text: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:23
text: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:24
text: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors

title: Psalms 119:25
text: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!

title: Psalms 119:26
text: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:27
text: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.

title: Psalms 119:28
text: My soul is weary with sorrow: strengthen me according to your word.

title: Psalms 119:29
text: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!

title: Psalms 119:30
text: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.

title: Psalms 119:31
text: I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don't let me be disappointed.

title: Psalms 119:32
text: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free

title: Psalms 119:33
text: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.

title: Psalms 119:34
text: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

title: Psalms 119:35
text: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.

title: Psalms 119:36
text: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.

title: Psalms 119:37
text: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.

title: Psalms 119:38
text: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

title: Psalms 119:39
text: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.

title: Psalms 119:40
text: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness

title: Psalms 119:41
text: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.

title: Psalms 119:42
text: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.

title: Psalms 119:43
text: Don't snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.

title: Psalms 119:44
text: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.

title: Psalms 119:45
text: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

title: Psalms 119:46
text: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

title: Psalms 119:47
text: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.

title: Psalms 119:48
text: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes

title: Psalms 119:49
text: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.

title: Psalms 119:50
text: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

title: Psalms 119:51
text: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don't swerve from your law.

title: Psalms 119:52
text: I remember your ordinances of old, Yahweh, and have comforted myself.

title: Psalms 119:53
text: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.

title: Psalms 119:54
text: Your statutes have been my songs, in the house where I live.

title: Psalms 119:55
text: I have remembered your name, Yahweh, in the night, and I obey your law.

title: Psalms 119:56
text: This is my way, that I keep your precepts

title: Psalms 119:57
text: Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.

title: Psalms 119:58
text: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.

title: Psalms 119:59
text: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:60
text: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:61
text: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won't forget your law.

title: Psalms 119:62
text: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.

title: Psalms 119:63
text: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.

title: Psalms 119:64
text: The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes

title: Psalms 119:65
text: Do good to your servant, according to your word, Yahweh.

title: Psalms 119:66
text: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:67
text: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.

title: Psalms 119:68
text: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:69
text: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.

title: Psalms 119:70
text: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.

title: Psalms 119:71
text: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:72
text: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver

title: Psalms 119:73
text: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:74
text: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.

title: Psalms 119:75
text: Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

title: Psalms 119:76
text: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

title: Psalms 119:77
text: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

title: Psalms 119:78
text: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.

title: Psalms 119:79
text: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:80
text: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed

title: Psalms 119:81
text: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

title: Psalms 119:82
text: My eyes fail for your word. I say, "When will you comfort me?"

title: Psalms 119:83
text: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don't forget your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:84
text: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?

title: Psalms 119:85
text: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.

title: Psalms 119:86
text: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!

title: Psalms 119:87
text: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn't forsake your precepts.

title: Psalms 119:88
text: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth

title: Psalms 119:89
text: Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.

title: Psalms 119:90
text: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.

title: Psalms 119:91
text: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.

title: Psalms 119:92
text: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

title: Psalms 119:93
text: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.

title: Psalms 119:94
text: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.

title: Psalms 119:95
text: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:96
text: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless

title: Psalms 119:97
text: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.

title: Psalms 119:98
text: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.

title: Psalms 119:99
text: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.

title: Psalms 119:100
text: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.

title: Psalms 119:101
text: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

title: Psalms 119:102
text: I have not turned aside from your ordinances, for you have taught me.

title: Psalms 119:103
text: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!

title: Psalms 119:104
text: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way

title: Psalms 119:105
text: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

title: Psalms 119:106
text: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

title: Psalms 119:107
text: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.

title: Psalms 119:108
text: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.

title: Psalms 119:109
text: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won't forget your law.

title: Psalms 119:110
text: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven't gone astray from your precepts.

title: Psalms 119:111
text: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

title: Psalms 119:112
text: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end

title: Psalms 119:113
text: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

title: Psalms 119:114
text: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

title: Psalms 119:115
text: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

title: Psalms 119:116
text: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.

title: Psalms 119:117
text: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

title: Psalms 119:118
text: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

title: Psalms 119:119
text: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:120
text: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments

title: Psalms 119:121
text: I have done what is just and righteous. Don't leave me to my oppressors.

title: Psalms 119:122
text: Ensure your servant's well-being. Don't let the proud oppress me.

title: Psalms 119:123
text: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.

title: Psalms 119:124
text: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:125
text: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:126
text: It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.

title: Psalms 119:127
text: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.

title: Psalms 119:128
text: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way

title: Psalms 119:129
text: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.

title: Psalms 119:130
text: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.

title: Psalms 119:131
text: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:132
text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

title: Psalms 119:133
text: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don't let any iniquity have dominion over me.

title: Psalms 119:134
text: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.

title: Psalms 119:135
text: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:136
text: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don't observe your law

title: Psalms 119:137
text: You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.

title: Psalms 119:138
text: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.

title: Psalms 119:139
text: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.

title: Psalms 119:140
text: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

title: Psalms 119:141
text: I am small and despised. I don't forget your precepts.

title: Psalms 119:142
text: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.

title: Psalms 119:143
text: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

title: Psalms 119:144
text: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live

title: Psalms 119:145
text: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:146
text: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:147
text: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.

title: Psalms 119:148
text: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.

title: Psalms 119:149
text: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.

title: Psalms 119:150
text: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.

title: Psalms 119:151
text: You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.

title: Psalms 119:152
text: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever

title: Psalms 119:153
text: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don't forget your law.

title: Psalms 119:154
text: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.

title: Psalms 119:155
text: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don't seek your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:156
text: Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.

title: Psalms 119:157
text: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven't swerved from your testimonies.

title: Psalms 119:158
text: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don't observe your word.

title: Psalms 119:159
text: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.

title: Psalms 119:160
text: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever

title: Psalms 119:161
text: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.

title: Psalms 119:162
text: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great spoil.

title: Psalms 119:163
text: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.

title: Psalms 119:164
text: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

title: Psalms 119:165
text: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

title: Psalms 119:166
text: I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh. I have done your commandments.

title: Psalms 119:167
text: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

title: Psalms 119:168
text: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you

title: Psalms 119:169
text: Let my cry come before you, Yahweh. Give me understanding according to your word.

title: Psalms 119:170
text: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

title: Psalms 119:171
text: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.

title: Psalms 119:172
text: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.

title: Psalms 119:173
text: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

title: Psalms 119:174
text: I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.

title: Psalms 119:175
text: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.

title: Psalms 119:176
text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don't forget your commandments

title: Psalms 120
inscription: A Song of degrees.

title: Psalms 120:1
text: In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.

title: Psalms 120:2
text: Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

title: Psalms 120:3
text: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

title: Psalms 120:4
text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

title: Psalms 120:5
text: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

title: Psalms 120:6
text: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.

title: Psalms 120:7
text: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war. A Song of Ascents.

title: Psalms 121
inscription: A Song of degrees.

title: Psalms 121:1
text: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

title: Psalms 121:2
text: My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

title: Psalms 121:3
text: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

title: Psalms 121:4
text: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

title: Psalms 121:5
text: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.

title: Psalms 121:6
text: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

title: Psalms 121:7
text: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

title: Psalms 121:8
text: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forth, and forevermore. A Song of Ascents. By David.

title: Psalms 122
inscription: A Song of degrees of David

title: Psalms 122:1
text: I was glad when they said to me, "Let's go to Yahweh's house!"

title: Psalms 122:2
text: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem;

title: Psalms 122:3
text: Jerusalem, that is built as a city that is compact together;

title: Psalms 122:4
text: where the tribes go up, even Yah's tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the name of Yahweh.

title: Psalms 122:5
text: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David's house.

title: Psalms 122:6
text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

title: Psalms 122:7
text: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

title: Psalms 122:8
text: For my brothers' and companions' sakes, I will now say, "Peace be within you."

title: Psalms 122:9
text: For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God, I will seek your good. A Song of Ascents.

title: Psalms 123
inscription: A Song of degrees

title: Psalms 123:1
text: To you I do lift up my eyes, you who sit in the heavens.

title: Psalms 123:2
text: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes look to Yahweh, our God, until he has mercy on us.

title: Psalms 123:3
text: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

title: Psalms 123:4
text: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud. A Song of Ascents. By David.

title: Psalms 124
inscription: A Song of degrees of David.

title: Psalms 124:1
text: If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,

title: Psalms 124:2
text: if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, when men rose up against us;

title: Psalms 124:3
text: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;

title: Psalms 124:4
text: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul;

title: Psalms 124:5
text: then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

title: Psalms 124:6
text: Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

title: Psalms 124:7
text: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler's snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

title: Psalms 124:8
text: Our help is in the name of Yahweh, who made heaven and earth. A Song of Ascents.

title: Psalms 125
inscription: A Song of degrees.

title: Psalms 125:1
text: Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can't be moved, but remains forever.

title: Psalms 125:2
text: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forth and forevermore.

title: Psalms 125:3
text: For the scepter of wickedness won't remain over the allotment of the righteous; so that the righteous won't use their hands to do evil.

title: Psalms 125:4
text: Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.

title: Psalms 125:5
text: But as for those who turn aside to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel. A Song of Ascents.

title: Psalms 126
inscription: A Song of degrees.

title: Psalms 126:1
