text: and gave them this land, which you swore to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;

title: Jeremiah 32:23
text: and they came in, and possessed it, but they didn't obey your voice, neither walked in your law; they have done nothing of all that you commanded them to do: therefore you have caused all this evil to come on them.

title: Jeremiah 32:24
text: Behold, the mounds, they are come to the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans who fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence; and what you have spoken has happened; and behold, you see it.

title: Jeremiah 32:25
text: You have said to me, Lord Yahweh, Buy the field for money, and call witnesses; whereas the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

title: Jeremiah 32:26
text: Then came the word of Yahweh to Jeremiah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 32:27
text: Behold, I am Yahweh, the God of all flesh: is there anything too hard for me?

title: Jeremiah 32:28
text: Therefore thus says Yahweh: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:

title: Jeremiah 32:29
text: and the Chaldeans, who fight against this city, shall come and set this city on fire, and burn it, with the houses, on whose roofs they have offered incense to Baal, and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke me to anger.

title: Jeremiah 32:30
text: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done only that which was evil in my sight from their youth; for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, says Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 32:31
text: For this city has been to me a provocation of my anger and of my wrath from the day that they built it even to this day; that I should remove it from before my face,

title: Jeremiah 32:32
text: because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 32:33
text: They have turned to me the back, and not the face: and though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not listened to receive instruction.

title: Jeremiah 32:34
text: But they set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

title: Jeremiah 32:35
text: They built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through [the fire] to Molech; which I didn't command them, neither did it come into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.

title: Jeremiah 32:36
text: Now therefore thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, concerning this city, about which you say, It is given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence:

title: Jeremiah 32:37
text: Behold, I will gather them out of all the countries, where I have driven them in my anger, and in my wrath, and in great indignation; and I will bring them again to this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:

title: Jeremiah 32:38
text: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God:

title: Jeremiah 32:39
text: and I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:

title: Jeremiah 32:40
text: and I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good; and I will put my fear in their hearts, that they may not depart from me.

title: Jeremiah 32:41
text: Yes, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.

title: Jeremiah 32:42
text: For thus says Yahweh: Like as I have brought all this great evil on this people, so will I bring on them all the good that I have promised them.

title: Jeremiah 32:43
text: Fields shall be bought in this land, about which you say, It is desolate, without man or animal; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

title: Jeremiah 32:44
text: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe the deeds, and seal them, and call witnesses, in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the hill country, and in the cities of the lowland, and in the cities of the South: for I will cause their captivity to return, says Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 33:1
text: Moreover the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the guard, saying,

title: Jeremiah 33:2
text: Thus says Yahweh who does it, Yahweh who forms it to establish it; Yahweh is his name:

title: Jeremiah 33:3
text: Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great things, and difficult, which you don't know.

title: Jeremiah 33:4
text: For thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are broken down [to make a defense] against the mounds and against the sword;

title: Jeremiah 33:5
text: while [men] come to fight with the Chaldeans, and to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have killed in my anger and in my wrath, and for all whose wickedness I have hidden my face from this city:

title: Jeremiah 33:6
text: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them; and I will reveal to them abundance of peace and truth.

title: Jeremiah 33:7
text: I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.

title: Jeremiah 33:8
text: I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, by which they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, by which they have sinned against me, and by which they have transgressed against me.

title: Jeremiah 33:9
text: [This city] shall be to me for a name of joy, for a praise and for a glory, before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do to them, and shall fear and tremble for all the good and for all the peace that I procure to it.

title: Jeremiah 33:10
text: Thus says Yahweh: Yet again there shall be heard in this place, about which you say, It is waste, without man and without animal, even in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man and without inhabitant and without animal,

title: Jeremiah 33:11
text: the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those who say, Give thanks to Yahweh of Armies, for Yahweh is good, for his loving kindness endures forever; [and of them] who bring [sacrifices of] thanksgiving into the house of Yahweh. For I will cause the captivity of the land to return as at the first, says Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 33:12
text: Thus says Yahweh of Armies: Yet again shall there be in this place, which is waste, without man and without animal, and in all its cities, a habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.

title: Jeremiah 33:13
text: In the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, and in the cities of the South, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks again pass under the hands of him who numbers them, says Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 33:14
text: Behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will perform that good word which I have spoken concerning the house of Israel and concerning the house of Judah.

title: Jeremiah 33:15
text: In those days, and at that time, will I cause a Branch of righteousness to grow up to David; and he shall execute justice and righteousness in the land.

title: Jeremiah 33:16
text: In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely; and this is [the name] by which she shall be called: Yahweh our righteousness.

title: Jeremiah 33:17
text: For thus says Yahweh: David shall never want a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel;

title: Jeremiah 33:18
text: neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to burn meal offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.

title: Jeremiah 33:19
text: The word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 33:20
text: Thus says Yahweh: If you can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, so that there shall not be day and night in their season;

title: Jeremiah 33:21
text: then may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he shall not have a son to reign on his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.

title: Jeremiah 33:22
text: As the army of the sky can't be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured; so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites who minister to me.

title: Jeremiah 33:23
text: The word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 33:24
text: Don't consider what this people has spoken, saying, The two families which Yahweh did choose, he has cast them off? thus do they despise my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.

title: Jeremiah 33:25
text: Thus says Yahweh: If my covenant of day and night fails, if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;

title: Jeremiah 33:26
text: then will I also cast away the seed of Jacob, and of David my servant, so that I will not take of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and will have mercy on them.

title: Jeremiah 34:1
text: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth that were under his dominion, and all the peoples, were fighting against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of it, saying:

title: Jeremiah 34:2
text: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, Go, and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:

title: Jeremiah 34:3
text: and you shall not escape out of his hand, but shall surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and your eyes shall see the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with you mouth to mouth, and you shall go to Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 34:4
text: Yet hear the word of Yahweh, O Zedekiah king of Judah: thus says Yahweh concerning you, You shall not die by the sword;

title: Jeremiah 34:5
text: you shall die in peace; and with the burnings of your fathers, the former kings who were before you, so shall they make a burning for you; and they shall lament you, [saying], Ah Lord! for I have spoken the word, says Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 34:6
text: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,

title: Jeremiah 34:7
text: when the king of Babylon's army was fighting against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish and against Azekah; for these [alone] remained of the cities of Judah [as] fortified cities.

title: Jeremiah 34:8
text: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people who were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty to them;

title: Jeremiah 34:9
text: that every man should let his male servant, and every man his female servant, who is a Hebrew or a Hebrewess, go free; that none should make bondservants of them, [to wit], of a Jew his brother.

title: Jeremiah 34:10
text: All the princes and all the people obeyed, who had entered into the covenant, that everyone should let his male servant, and everyone his female servant, go free, that none should make bondservants of them any more; they obeyed, and let them go:

title: Jeremiah 34:11
text: but afterwards they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.

title: Jeremiah 34:12
text: Therefore the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

title: Jeremiah 34:13
text: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel: I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage, saying,

title: Jeremiah 34:14
text: At the end of seven years you shall let go every man his brother who is a Hebrew, who has been sold to you, and has served you six years, you shall let him go free from you: but your fathers didn't listen to me, neither inclined their ear.

title: Jeremiah 34:15
text: You had now turned, and had done that which is right in my eyes, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbor; and you had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:

title: Jeremiah 34:16
text: but you turned and profaned my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom you had let go free at their pleasure, to return; and you brought them into subjection, to be to you for servants and for handmaids.

title: Jeremiah 34:17
text: Therefore thus says Yahweh: you have not listened to me, to proclaim liberty, every man to his brother, and every man to his neighbor: behold, I proclaim to you a liberty, says Yahweh, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 34:18
text: I will give the men who have transgressed my covenant, who have not performed the words of the covenant which they made before me, when they cut the calf in two and passed between its parts;

title: Jeremiah 34:19
text: the princes of Judah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, who passed between the parts of the calf;

title: Jeremiah 34:20
text: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life; and their dead bodies shall be for food to the birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth.

title: Jeremiah 34:21
text: Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, who have gone away from you.

title: Jeremiah 34:22
text: Behold, I will command, says Yahweh, and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.

title: Jeremiah 35:1
text: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 35:2
text: Go to the house of the Rechabites, and speak to them, and bring them into the house of Yahweh, into one of the rooms, and give them wine to drink.

title: Jeremiah 35:3
text: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, and his brothers, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;

title: Jeremiah 35:4
text: and I brought them into the house of Yahweh, into the room of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was by the room of the princes, which was above the room of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the threshold.

title: Jeremiah 35:5
text: I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups; and I said to them, Drink wine!

title: Jeremiah 35:6
text: But they said, We will drink no wine; for Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, commanded us, saying, You shall drink no wine, neither you, nor your sons, forever:

title: Jeremiah 35:7
text: neither shall you build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any; but all your days you shall dwell in tents; that you may live many days in the land in which you live.

title: Jeremiah 35:8
text: We have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, in all that he commanded us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, or our daughters;

title: Jeremiah 35:9
text: nor to build houses for us to dwell in; neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:

title: Jeremiah 35:10
text: but we have lived in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

title: Jeremiah 35:11
text: But it happened, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians; so we dwell at Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 35:12
text: Then came the word of Yahweh to Jeremiah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 35:13
text: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Go, and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will you not receive instruction to listen to my words? says Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 35:14
text: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons, not to drink wine, are performed; and to this day they drink none, for they obey their father's commandment: but I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; and you have not listened to me.

title: Jeremiah 35:15
text: I have sent also to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Return now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and don't go after other gods to serve them, and you shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but you have not inclined your ear, nor listened to me.

title: Jeremiah 35:16
text: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father which he commanded them, but this people has not listened to me;

title: Jeremiah 35:17
text: therefore thus says Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them; because I have spoken to them, but they have not heard; and I have called to them, but they have not answered.

title: Jeremiah 35:18
text: Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according to all that he commanded you;

title: Jeremiah 35:19
text: therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me forever.

title: Jeremiah 36:1
text: It happened in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, that this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

title: Jeremiah 36:2
text: Take a scroll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah, even to this day.

title: Jeremiah 36:3
text: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do to them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.

title: Jeremiah 36:4
text: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah; and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of Yahweh, which he had spoken to him, on a scroll of a book.

title: Jeremiah 36:5
text: Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am shut up; I can't go into the house of Yahweh:

title: Jeremiah 36:6
text: therefore you go, and read in the scroll, which you have written from my mouth, the words of Yahweh in the ears of the people in Yahweh's house on the fast day; and also you shall read them in the ears of all Judah who come out of their cities.

title: Jeremiah 36:7
text: It may be they will present their supplication before Yahweh, and will return everyone from his evil way; for great is the anger and the wrath that Yahweh has pronounced against this people.

title: Jeremiah 36:8
text: Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of Yahweh in Yahweh's house.

title: Jeremiah 36:9
text: Now it happened in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, in the ninth month, that all the people in Jerusalem, and all the people who came from the cities of Judah to Jerusalem, proclaimed a fast before Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 36:10
text: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of Yahweh, in the room of Gemariah the son of Shaphan, the scribe, in the upper court, at the entry of the new gate of Yahweh's house, in the ears of all the people.

title: Jeremiah 36:11
text: When Micaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of Yahweh,

title: Jeremiah 36:12
text: he went down into the king's house, into the scribe's room: and behold, all the princes were sitting there, [to wit], Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.

title: Jeremiah 36:13
text: Then Micaiah declared to them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.

title: Jeremiah 36:14
text: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, Take in your hand the scroll in which you have read in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand, and came to them.

title: Jeremiah 36:15
text: They said to him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read it in their ears.

title: Jeremiah 36:16
text: Now it happened, when they had heard all the words, they turned in fear one toward another, and said to Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.

title: Jeremiah 36:17
text: They asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How did you write all these words at his mouth?

title: Jeremiah 36:18
text: Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words to me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.

title: Jeremiah 36:19
text: Then the princes said to Baruch, Go, hide, you and Jeremiah; and let no man know where you are.

title: Jeremiah 36:20
text: They went in to the king into the court; but they had laid up the scroll in the room of Elishama the scribe; and they told all the words in the ears of the king.

title: Jeremiah 36:21
text: So the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll; and he took it out of the room of Elishama the scribe. Jehudi read it in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the princes who stood beside the king.

title: Jeremiah 36:22
text: Now the king was sitting in the winter house in the ninth month: and [there was a fire in] the brazier burning before him.

title: Jeremiah 36:23
text: It happened, when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, that [the king] cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was in the brazier, until all the scroll was consumed in the fire that was in the brazier.

title: Jeremiah 36:24
text: They were not afraid, nor tore their garments, neither the king, nor any of his servants who heard all these words.

title: Jeremiah 36:25
text: Moreover Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the scroll; but he would not hear them.

title: Jeremiah 36:26
text: The king commanded Jerahmeel the king's son, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet; but Yahweh hid them.

title: Jeremiah 36:27
text: Then the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah, after that the king had burned the scroll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 36:28
text: Take again another scroll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first scroll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah has burned.

title: Jeremiah 36:29
text: Concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah you shall say, Thus says Yahweh: You have burned this scroll, saying, Why have you written therein, saying, The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land, and shall cause to cease from there man and animal?

title: Jeremiah 36:30
text: Therefore thus says Yahweh concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: He shall have none to sit on the throne of David; and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

title: Jeremiah 36:31
text: I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity; and I will bring on them, and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and on the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them, but they didn't listen.

title: Jeremiah 36:32
text: Then took Jeremiah another scroll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah, who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire; and there were added besides to them many like words.

title: Jeremiah 37:1
text: Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned as king, instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.

title: Jeremiah 37:2
text: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, did listen to the words of Yahweh, which he spoke by the prophet Jeremiah.

title: Jeremiah 37:3
text: Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, Pray now to Yahweh our God for us.

title: Jeremiah 37:4
text: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people; for they had not put him into prison.

title: Jeremiah 37:5
text: Pharaoh's army was come forth out of Egypt; and when the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem heard news of them, they broke up from Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 37:6
text: Then came the word of Yahweh to the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 37:7
text: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, You shall tell the king of Judah, who sent you to me to inquire of me: Behold, Pharaoh's army, which is come forth to help you, shall return to Egypt into their own land.

title: Jeremiah 37:8
text: The Chaldeans shall come again, and fight against this city; and they shall take it, and burn it with fire.

title: Jeremiah 37:9
text: Thus says Yahweh, Don't deceive yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us; for they shall not depart.

title: Jeremiah 37:10
text: For though you had struck the whole army of the Chaldeans who fight against you, and there remained but wounded men among them, yes would they rise up every man in his tent, and burn this city with fire.

title: Jeremiah 37:11
text: It happened that, when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh's army,

title: Jeremiah 37:12
text: then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to receive his portion there, in the midst of the people.

title: Jeremiah 37:13
text: When he was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the guard was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he laid hold on Jeremiah the prophet, saying, You are falling away to the Chaldeans.

title: Jeremiah 37:14
text: Then Jeremiah said, It is false; I am not falling away to the Chaldeans. But he didn't listen to him; so Irijah laid hold on Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.

title: Jeremiah 37:15
text: The princes were angry with Jeremiah, and struck him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe; for they had made that the prison.

title: Jeremiah 37:16
text: When Jeremiah was come into the dungeon house, and into the cells, and Jeremiah had remained there many days;

title: Jeremiah 37:17
text: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and fetched him: and the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there any word from Yahweh? Jeremiah said, There is. He said also, You shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 37:18
text: Moreover Jeremiah said to king Zedekiah, Wherein have I sinned against you, or against your servants, or against this people, that you have put me in prison?

title: Jeremiah 37:19
text: Where now are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?

title: Jeremiah 37:20
text: Now please hear, my lord the king: please let my supplication be presented before you, that you not cause me to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.

title: Jeremiah 37:21
text: Then Zedekiah the king commanded, and they committed Jeremiah into the court of the guard; and they gave him daily a loaf of bread out of the bakers' street, until all the bread in the city was spent. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.

title: Jeremiah 38:1
text: Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashhur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur the son of Malchijah, heard the words that Jeremiah spoke to all the people, saying,

title: Jeremiah 38:2
text: Thus says Yahweh, He who remains in this city shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence; but he who goes forth to the Chaldeans shall live, and his life shall be to him for a prey, and he shall live.

title: Jeremiah 38:3
text: Thus says Yahweh, This city shall surely be given into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it.

title: Jeremiah 38:4
text: Then the princes said to the king, "Please let this man be put to death; because he weakens the hands of the men of war who remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words to them: for this man doesn't seek the welfare of this people, but the hurt."

title: Jeremiah 38:5
text: Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he is in your hand; for the king is not he who can do anything against you.

title: Jeremiah 38:6
text: Then took they Jeremiah, and cast him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king's son, that was in the court of the guard: and they let down Jeremiah with cords. In the dungeon there was no water, but mire; and Jeremiah sank in the mire.

title: Jeremiah 38:7
text: Now when Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, a eunuch, who was in the king's house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon (the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin),

title: Jeremiah 38:8
text: Ebedmelech went forth out of the king's house, and spoke to the king, saying,

title: Jeremiah 38:9
text: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is likely to die in the place where he is, because of the famine; for there is no more bread in the city.

title: Jeremiah 38:10
text: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from here thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he dies.

title: Jeremiah 38:11
text: So Ebedmelech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took there rags and worn-out garments, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.

title: Jeremiah 38:12
text: Ebedmelech the Ethiopian said to Jeremiah, Put now these rags and worn-out garments under your armpits under the cords. Jeremiah did so.

title: Jeremiah 38:13
text: So they drew up Jeremiah with the cords, and took him up out of the dungeon: and Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.

title: Jeremiah 38:14
text: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took Jeremiah the prophet to him into the third entry that is in the house of Yahweh: and the king said to Jeremiah, I will ask you something. Hide nothing from me.

title: Jeremiah 38:15
text: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, If I declare it to you, will you not surely put me to death? and if I give you counsel, you will not listen to me.

title: Jeremiah 38:16
text: So Zedekiah the king swore secretly to Jeremiah, saying, As Yahweh lives, who made us this soul, I will not put you to death, neither will I give you into the hand of these men who seek your life.

title: Jeremiah 38:17
text: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, Thus says Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel: If you will go forth to the king of Babylon's princes, then your soul shall live, and this city shall not be burned with fire; and you shall live, and your house.

title: Jeremiah 38:18
text: But if you will not go forth to the king of Babylon's princes, then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and you shall not escape out of their hand.

title: Jeremiah 38:19
text: Zedekiah the king said to Jeremiah, I am afraid of the Jews who are fallen away to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.

title: Jeremiah 38:20
text: But Jeremiah said, They shall not deliver you. Obey, I beg you, the voice of Yahweh, in that which I speak to you: so it shall be well with you, and your soul shall live.

title: Jeremiah 38:21
text: But if you refuse to go forth, this is the word that Yahweh has shown me:

title: Jeremiah 38:22
text: behold, all the women who are left in the king of Judah's house shall be brought forth to the king of Babylon's princes, and those women shall say, Your familiar friends have set you on, and have prevailed over you: [now that] your feet are sunk in the mire, they are turned away back.

title: Jeremiah 38:23
text: They shall bring out all your wives and your children to the Chaldeans; and you shall not escape out of their hand, but shall be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon: and you shall cause this city to be burned with fire.

title: Jeremiah 38:24
text: Then Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and you shall not die.

title: Jeremiah 38:25
text: But if the princes hear that I have talked with you, and they come to you, and tell you, Declare to us now what you have said to the king; don't hide it from us, and we will not put you to death; also what the king said to you:

title: Jeremiah 38:26
text: then you shall tell them, I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan's house, to die there.

title: Jeremiah 38:27
text: Then came all the princes to Jeremiah, and asked him; and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they left off speaking with him; for the matter was not perceived.

title: Jeremiah 38:28
text: So Jeremiah stayed in the court of the guard until the day that Jerusalem was taken.

title: Jeremiah 39:1
text: It happened when Jerusalem was taken, (in the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem, and besieged it;

title: Jeremiah 39:2
text: in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, a breach was made in the city),

title: Jeremiah 39:3
text: that all the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate, [to wit], Nergal Sharezer, Samgarnebo, Sarsechim, Rabsaris, Nergal Sharezer, Rabmag, with all the rest of the princes of the king of Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 39:4
text: It happened that, when Zedekiah the king of Judah and all the men of war saw them, then they fled, and went forth out of the city by night, by the way of the king's garden, through the gate between the two walls; and he went out toward the Arabah.

title: Jeremiah 39:5
text: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho: and when they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he gave judgment on him.

title: Jeremiah 39:6
text: Then the king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before his eyes: also the king of Babylon killed all the nobles of Judah.

title: Jeremiah 39:7
text: Moreover he put out Zedekiah's eyes, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 39:8
text: The Chaldeans burned the king's house, and the houses of the people, with fire, and broke down the walls of Jerusalem.

title: Jeremiah 39:9
text: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the residue of the people who remained in the city, the deserters also who fell away to him, and the residue of the people who remained.

title: Jeremiah 39:10
text: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, who had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.

title: Jeremiah 39:11
text: Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon commanded Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard concerning Jeremiah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 39:12
text: Take him, and look well to him, and do him no harm; but do to him even as he shall tell you.

title: Jeremiah 39:13
text: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard sent, and Nebushazban, Rabsaris, and Nergal Sharezer, Rabmag, and all the chief officers of the king of Babylon;

title: Jeremiah 39:14
text: they sent, and took Jeremiah out of the court of the guard, and committed him to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, that he should carry him home: so he lived among the people.

title: Jeremiah 39:15
text: Now the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah, while he was shut up in the court of the guard, saying,

title: Jeremiah 39:16
text: Go, and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring my words on this city for evil, and not for good; and they shall be accomplished before you in that day.

title: Jeremiah 39:17
text: But I will deliver you in that day, says Yahweh; and you shall not be given into the hand of the men of whom you are afraid.

title: Jeremiah 39:18
text: For I will surely save you, and you shall not fall by the sword, but your life shall be for a prey to you; because you have put your trust in me, says Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 40:1
text: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, after that Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all the captives of Jerusalem and Judah, who were carried away captive to Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 40:2
text: The captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said to him, Yahweh your God pronounced this evil on this place;

title: Jeremiah 40:3
text: and Yahweh has brought it, and done according as he spoke: because you have sinned against Yahweh, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing has come on you.

title: Jeremiah 40:4
text: Now, behold, I release you this day from the chains which are on your hand. If it seems good to you to come with me into Babylon, come, and I will take care of you; but if it seems bad to you to come with me into Babylon, don't: behold, all the land is before you; where it seems good and right to you to go, there go.

title: Jeremiah 40:5
text: Now while he was not yet gone back, Go back then, [said he], to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people; or go wherever it seems right to you to go. So the captain of the guard gave him food and a present, and let him go.

title: Jeremiah 40:6
text: Then went Jeremiah to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah, and lived with him among the people who were left in the land.

title: Jeremiah 40:7
text: Now when all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, even they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed to him men, and women, and children, and of the poorest of the land, of those who were not carried away captive to Babylon;

title: Jeremiah 40:8
text: then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, [to wit], Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

title: Jeremiah 40:9
text: Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan swore to them and to their men, saying, Don't be afraid to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.

title: Jeremiah 40:10
text: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah, to stand before the Chaldeans who shall come to us: but you, gather wine and summer fruits and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that you have taken.

title: Jeremiah 40:11
text: Likewise when all the Jews who were in Moab, and among the children of Ammon, and in Edom, and who were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan;

title: Jeremiah 40:12
text: then all the Jews returned out of all places where they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, to Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.

title: Jeremiah 40:13
text: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,

title: Jeremiah 40:14
text: and said to him, Do you know that Baalis the king of the children of Ammon has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to take your life? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam didn't believe them.

title: Jeremiah 40:15
text: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Please let me go, and I will kill Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man shall know it: why should he take your life, that all the Jews who are gathered to you should be scattered, and the remnant of Judah perish?

title: Jeremiah 40:16
text: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said to Johanan the son of Kareah, You shall not do this thing; for you speak falsely of Ishmael.

title: Jeremiah 41:1
text: Now it happened in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal and [one of] the chief officers of the king, and ten men with him, came to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they ate bread together in Mizpah.

title: Jeremiah 41:2
text: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten men who were with him, and struck Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and killed him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.

title: Jeremiah 41:3
text: Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with him, [to wit], with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans who were found there, the men of war.

title: Jeremiah 41:4
text: It happened the second day after he had killed Gedaliah, and no man knew it,

title: Jeremiah 41:5
text: that there came men from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even eighty men, having their beards shaved and their clothes torn, and having cut themselves, with meal offerings and frankincense in their hand, to bring them to the house of Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 41:6
text: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it happened, as he met them, he said to them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.

title: Jeremiah 41:7
text: It was so, when they came into the midst of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah killed them, [and cast them] into the midst of the pit, he, and the men who were with him.

title: Jeremiah 41:8
text: But ten men were found among those who said to Ishmael, Don't kill us; for we have stores hidden in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he stopped, and didn't kill them among their brothers.

title: Jeremiah 41:9
text: Now the pit in which Ishmael cast all the dead bodies of the men whom he had killed, by the side of Gedaliah (the same was who which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel), Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with those who were killed.

title: Jeremiah 41:10
text: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people who were in Mizpah, even the king's daughters, and all the people who remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam; Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the children of Ammon.

title: Jeremiah 41:11
text: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,

title: Jeremiah 41:12
text: then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.

title: Jeremiah 41:13
text: Now it happened that, when all the people who were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, then they were glad.

title: Jeremiah 41:14
text: So all the people who Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned about and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.

title: Jeremiah 41:15
text: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the children of Ammon.

title: Jeremiah 41:16
text: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, [to wit], the men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought back from Gibeon:

title: Jeremiah 41:17
text: and they departed, and lived in Geruth Chimham, which is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt,

title: Jeremiah 41:18
text: because of the Chaldeans; for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor over the land.

title: Jeremiah 42:1
text: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even to the greatest, came near,

title: Jeremiah 42:2
text: and said to Jeremiah the prophet, Please let our supplication be presented before you, and pray for us to Yahweh your God, even for all this remnant; for we are left but a few of many, as your eyes do see us:

title: Jeremiah 42:3
text: that Yahweh your God may show us the way in which we should walk, and the thing that we should do.

title: Jeremiah 42:4
text: Then Jeremiah the prophet said to them, I have heard you; behold, I will pray to Yahweh your God according to your words; and it shall happen that whatever thing Yahweh shall answer you, I will declare it to you; I will keep nothing back from you.

title: Jeremiah 42:5
text: Then they said to Jeremiah, Yahweh be a true and faithful witness among us, if we don't do according to all the word with which Yahweh your God shall send you to us.

title: Jeremiah 42:6
text: Whether it be good, or whether it be evil, we will obey the voice of Yahweh our God, to whom we send you; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of Yahweh our God.

title: Jeremiah 42:7
text: It happened after ten days, that the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah.

title: Jeremiah 42:8
text: Then called he Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,

title: Jeremiah 42:9
text: and said to them, Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your supplication before him:

title: Jeremiah 42:10
text: If you will still live in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up; for I grieve over the distress that I have brought on you.

title: Jeremiah 42:11
text: Don't be afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid; don't be afraid of him, says Yahweh: for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.

title: Jeremiah 42:12
text: I will grant you mercy, that he may have mercy on you, and cause you to return to your own land.

title: Jeremiah 42:13
text: But if you say, We will not dwell in this land; so that you don't obey the voice of Yahweh your God,

title: Jeremiah 42:14
text: saying, No; but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there will we dwell:

title: Jeremiah 42:15
text: now therefore hear the word of Yahweh, O remnant of Judah: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, If you indeed set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to live there;

title: Jeremiah 42:16
text: then it shall happen, that the sword, which you fear, shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt; and the famine, about which you are afraid, shall follow close behind you there in Egypt; and there you shall die.

title: Jeremiah 42:17
text: So shall it be with all the men who set their faces to go into Egypt to live there: they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence; and none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring on them.

title: Jeremiah 42:18
text: For thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: As my anger and my wrath has been poured forth on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so shall my wrath be poured forth on you, when you shall enter into Egypt; and you shall be an object of horror, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach; and you shall see this place no more.

title: Jeremiah 42:19
text: Yahweh has spoken concerning you, remnant of Judah, Don't you go into Egypt: know certainly that I have testified to you this day.

title: Jeremiah 42:20
text: For you have dealt deceitfully against your own souls; for you sent me to Yahweh your God, saying, Pray for us to Yahweh our God; and according to all that Yahweh our God shall say, so declare to us, and we will do it:

title: Jeremiah 42:21
text: and I have this day declared it to you; but you have not obeyed the voice of Yahweh your God in anything for which he has sent me to you.

title: Jeremiah 42:22
text: Now therefore know certainly that you shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, in the place where you desire to go to live there.

title: Jeremiah 43:1
text: It happened that, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking to all the people all the words of Yahweh their God, with which Yahweh their God had sent him to them, even all these words,

title: Jeremiah 43:2
text: then spoke Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men, saying to Jeremiah, You speak falsely: Yahweh our God has not sent you to say, You shall not go into Egypt to live there;

title: Jeremiah 43:3
text: but Baruch the son of Neriah sets you on against us, to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they may put us to death, and carry us away captive to Babylon.

title: Jeremiah 43:4
text: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, didn't obey the voice of Yahweh, to dwell in the land of Judah.

title: Jeremiah 43:5
text: But Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, took all the remnant of Judah, who were returned from all the nations where they had been driven, to live in the land of Judah;

title: Jeremiah 43:6
text: the men, and the women, and the children, and the king's daughters, and every person who Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan; and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah;

title: Jeremiah 43:7
text: and they came into the land of Egypt; for they didn't obey the voice of Yahweh: and they came to Tahpanhes.

title: Jeremiah 43:8
text: Then came the word of Yahweh to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

title: Jeremiah 43:9
text: Take great stones in your hand, and hide them in mortar in the brick work, which is at the entry of Pharaoh's house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah;

title: Jeremiah 43:10
text: and tell them, Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne on these stones that I have hidden; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.

title: Jeremiah 43:11
text: He shall come, and shall strike the land of Egypt; such as are for death [shall be given] to death, and such as are for captivity to captivity, and such as are for the sword to the sword.

title: Jeremiah 43:12
text: I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them, and carry them away captive: and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd puts on his garment; and he shall go forth from there in peace.

title: Jeremiah 43:13
text: He shall also break the pillars of Beth Shemesh, that is in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of Egypt shall he burn with fire.

title: Jeremiah 44:1
text: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews who lived in the land of Egypt, who lived at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Memphis, and in the country of Pathros, saying,

title: Jeremiah 44:2
text: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: You have seen all the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, and on all the cities of Judah; and behold, this day they are a desolation, and no man dwells therein,

title: Jeremiah 44:3
text: because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, [and] to serve other gods, that they didn't know, neither they, nor you, nor your fathers.

title: Jeremiah 44:4
text: However I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Oh, don't do this abominable thing that I hate.

title: Jeremiah 44:5
text: But they didn't listen, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense to other gods.

title: Jeremiah 44:6
text: Therefore my wrath and my anger was poured forth, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as it is this day.

title: Jeremiah 44:7
text: Therefore now thus says Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel: Why do you commit great evil against your own souls, to cut off from yourselves man and woman, infant and nursing child out of the midst of Judah, to leave yourselves none remaining;

title: Jeremiah 44:8
text: in that you provoke me to anger with the works of your hands, burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt, where you have gone to live; that you may be cut off, and that you may be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?

title: Jeremiah 44:9
text: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Judah, and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives which they committed in the land of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?

title: Jeremiah 44:10
text: They are not humbled even to this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.

title: Jeremiah 44:11
text: Therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, even to cut off all Judah.

title: Jeremiah 44:12
text: I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to live there, and they shall all be consumed; in the land of Egypt shall they fall; they shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine; they shall die, from the least even to the greatest, by the sword and by the famine; and they shall be an object of horror, [and] an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.

title: Jeremiah 44:13
text: For I will punish those who dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence;

title: Jeremiah 44:14
text: so that none of the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, shall escape or be left, to return into the land of Judah, to which they have a desire to return to dwell there: for none shall return save such as shall escape.

title: Jeremiah 44:15
text: Then all the men who knew that their wives burned incense to other gods, and all the women who stood by, a great assembly, even all the people who lived in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 44:16
text: As for the word that you have spoken to us in the name of Yahweh, we will not listen to you.

title: Jeremiah 44:17
text: But we will certainly perform every word that is gone forth out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to her, as we have done, we and our fathers, our kings and our princes, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem; for then had we plenty of food, and were well, and saw no evil.

title: Jeremiah 44:18
text: But since we left off burning incense to the queen of the sky, and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have wanted all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.

title: Jeremiah 44:19
text: When we burned incense to the queen of the sky, and poured out drink offerings to her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings to her, without our husbands?

title: Jeremiah 44:20
text: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, to the men, and to the women, even to all the people who had given him an answer, saying,

title: Jeremiah 44:21
text: The incense that you burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, you and your fathers, your kings and your princes, and the people of the land, didn't Yahweh remember them, and didn't it come into his mind?

title: Jeremiah 44:22
text: so that Yahweh could no longer bear, because of the evil of your doings, and because of the abominations which you have committed; therefore your land has become a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without inhabitant, as it is this day.

title: Jeremiah 44:23
text: Because you have burned incense, and because you have sinned against Yahweh, and have not obeyed the voice of Yahweh, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil has happened to you, as it is this day.

title: Jeremiah 44:24
text: Moreover Jeremiah said to all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of Yahweh, all Judah who are in the land of Egypt:

title: Jeremiah 44:25
text: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, saying, You and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and with your hands have fulfilled it, saying, We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to her: establish then your vows, and perform your vows.

title: Jeremiah 44:26
text: Therefore hear the word of Yahweh, all Judah who dwell in the land of Egypt: Behold, I have sworn by my great name, says Yahweh, that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, As the Lord Yahweh lives.

title: Jeremiah 44:27
text: Behold, I watch over them for evil, and not for good; and all the men of Judah who are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.

title: Jeremiah 44:28
text: Those who escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah, few in number; and all the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, shall know whose word shall stand, mine, or theirs.

title: Jeremiah 44:29
text: This shall be the sign to you, says Yahweh, that I will punish you in this place, that you may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil:

title: Jeremiah 44:30
text: Thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will give Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of those who seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who was his enemy, and sought his life.

title: Jeremiah 45:1
text: The message that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch the son of Neriah, when he wrote these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,

title: Jeremiah 45:2
text: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, to you, Baruch:

title: Jeremiah 45:3
text: You said, Woe is me now! for Yahweh has added sorrow to my pain; I am weary with my groaning, and I find no rest.

title: Jeremiah 45:4
text: You shall tell him, Thus says Yahweh: Behold, that which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up; and this in the whole land.

title: Jeremiah 45:5
text: Do you seek great things for yourself? Don't seek them; for, behold, I will bring evil on all flesh, says Yahweh; but your life will I give to you for a prey in all places where you go.

title: Jeremiah 46:1
text: The word of Yahweh which came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.

title: Jeremiah 46:2
text: Of Egypt: concerning the army of Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.

title: Jeremiah 46:3
text: Prepare the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle!

title: Jeremiah 46:4
text: Harness the horses, and get up, you horsemen, and stand forth with your helmets; furbish the spears, put on the coats of mail.

title: Jeremiah 46:5
text: Why have I seen it? they are dismayed and are turned backward; and their mighty ones are beaten down, and have fled apace, and don't look back: terror is on every side, says Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 46:6
text: Don't let the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; in the north by the river Euphrates have they stumbled and fallen.

title: Jeremiah 46:7
text: Who is this who rises up like the Nile, whose waters toss themselves like the rivers?

title: Jeremiah 46:8
text: Egypt rises up like the Nile, and his waters toss themselves like the rivers: and he says, I will rise up, I will cover the earth; I will destroy cities and its inhabitants.

title: Jeremiah 46:9
text: Go up, you horses; and rage, you chariots; and let the mighty men go forth: Cush and Put, who handle the shield; and the Ludim, who handle and bend the bow.

title: Jeremiah 46:10
text: For that day is [a day] of the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour and be satiate, and shall drink its fill of their blood; for the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, has a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.

title: Jeremiah 46:11
text: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, virgin daughter of Egypt: in vain do you use many medicines; there is no healing for you.

title: Jeremiah 46:12
text: The nations have heard of your shame, and the earth is full of your cry; for the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty, they are fallen both of them together.

title: Jeremiah 46:13
text: The word that Yahweh spoke to Jeremiah the prophet, how that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon should come and strike the land of Egypt.

title: Jeremiah 46:14
text: Declare in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Memphis and in Tahpanhes: say, Stand forth, and prepare; for the sword has devoured around you.

title: Jeremiah 46:15
text: Why are your strong ones swept away? they didn't stand, because Yahweh did drive them.

title: Jeremiah 46:16
text: He made many to stumble, yes, they fell one on another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our birth, from the oppressing sword.

title: Jeremiah 46:17
text: They cried there, Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he has let the appointed time pass by.

title: Jeremiah 46:18
text: As I live, says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies, surely like Tabor among the mountains, and like Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.

title: Jeremiah 46:19
text: You daughter who dwells in Egypt, furnish yourself to go into captivity; for Memphis shall become a desolation, and shall be burnt up, without inhabitant.

title: Jeremiah 46:20
text: Egypt is a very beautiful heifer; [but] destruction out of the north is come, it is come.

title: Jeremiah 46:21
text: Also her hired men in the midst of her are like calves of the stall; for they also are turned back, they are fled away together, they didn't stand: for the day of their calamity is come on them, the time of their visitation.

title: Jeremiah 46:22
text: The sound of it shall go like the serpent; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as wood cutters.

title: Jeremiah 46:23
text: They shall cut down her forest, says Yahweh, though it can't be searched; because they are more than the locusts, and are innumerable.

title: Jeremiah 46:24
text: The daughter of Egypt shall be disappointed; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.

title: Jeremiah 46:25
text: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Behold, I will punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with her gods, and her kings; even Pharaoh, and those who trust in him:

title: Jeremiah 46:26
text: and I will deliver them into the hand of those who seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants; and afterwards it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, says Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 46:27
text: But don't you be afraid, Jacob my servant, neither be dismayed, Israel: for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be quiet and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.

title: Jeremiah 46:28
text: Don't you be afraid, O Jacob my servant, says Yahweh; for I am with you: for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have driven you; but I will not make a full end of you, but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.

title: Jeremiah 47:1
text: The word of Yahweh that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before that Pharaoh struck Gaza.

title: Jeremiah 47:2
text: Thus says Yahweh: Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall become an overflowing stream, and shall overflow the land and all that is therein, the city and those who dwell therein; and the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall wail.

title: Jeremiah 47:3
text: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers don't look back to their children for feebleness of hands;

title: Jeremiah 47:4
text: because of the day that comes to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper who remains: for Yahweh will destroy the Philistines, the remnant of the isle of Caphtor.

title: Jeremiah 47:5
text: Baldness is come on Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nothing, the remnant of their valley: how long will you cut yourself?

title: Jeremiah 47:6
text: You sword of Yahweh, how long will it be before you be quiet? Put up yourself into your scabbard; rest, and be still.

title: Jeremiah 47:7
text: How can you be quiet, since Yahweh has given you a command? Against Ashkelon, and against the seashore, there has he appointed it.

title: Jeremiah 48:1
text: Of Moab. Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Woe to Nebo! for it is laid waste; Kiriathaim is disappointed, it is taken; Misgab is put to shame and broken down.

title: Jeremiah 48:2
text: The praise of Moab is no more; in Heshbon they have devised evil against her: Come, and let us cut her off from being a nation. You also, Madmen, shall be brought to silence: the sword shall pursue you.

title: Jeremiah 48:3
text: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!

title: Jeremiah 48:4
text: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

title: Jeremiah 48:5
text: For by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping shall they go up; for at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.

title: Jeremiah 48:6
text: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.

title: Jeremiah 48:7
text: For, because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also shall be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

title: Jeremiah 48:8
text: The destroyer shall come on every city, and no city shall escape; the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed; as Yahweh has spoken.

title: Jeremiah 48:9
text: Give wings to Moab, that she may fly and get her away: and her cities shall become a desolation, without any to dwell therein.

title: Jeremiah 48:10
text: Cursed is he who does the work of Yahweh negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.

title: Jeremiah 48:11
text: Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his lees, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remains in him, and his scent is not changed.

title: Jeremiah 48:12
text: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will send to him those who pour off, and they shall pour him off; and they shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles in pieces.

title: Jeremiah 48:13
text: Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence.

title: Jeremiah 48:14
text: How do you say, We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war?

title: Jeremiah 48:15
text: Moab is laid waste, and they are gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies.

title: Jeremiah 48:16
text: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hurries fast.

title: Jeremiah 48:17
text: All you who are around him, bemoan him, and all you who know his name; say, How is the strong staff broken, the beautiful rod!

title: Jeremiah 48:18
text: You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up against you, he has destroyed your strongholds.

title: Jeremiah 48:19
text: Inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and watch: ask him who flees, and her who escapes; say, What has been done?

title: Jeremiah 48:20
text: Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down: wail and cry; tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.

title: Jeremiah 48:21
text: Judgment is come on the plain country, on Holon, and on Jahzah, and on Mephaath,

title: Jeremiah 48:22
text: and on Dibon, and on Nebo, and on Beth Diblathaim,

title: Jeremiah 48:23
text: and on Kiriathaim, and on Beth Gamul, and on Beth Meon,

title: Jeremiah 48:24
text: and on Kerioth, and on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

title: Jeremiah 48:25
text: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, says Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 48:26
text: Make him drunken; for he magnified himself against Yahweh: and Moab shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.

title: Jeremiah 48:27
text: For wasn't Israel a derision to you? was he found among thieves? for as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.

title: Jeremiah 48:28
text: You inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock; and be like the dove that makes her nest over the mouth of the abyss.

title: Jeremiah 48:29
text: We have heard of the pride of Moab, [that] he is very proud; his loftiness, and his pride, and his arrogance, and the haughtiness of his heart.

title: Jeremiah 48:30
text: I know his wrath, says Yahweh, that it is nothing; his boastings have worked nothing.

title: Jeremiah 48:31
text: Therefore will I wail for Moab; yes, I will cry out for all Moab: for the men of Kir Heres shall they mourn.

title: Jeremiah 48:32
text: With more than the weeping of Jazer will I weep for you, vine of Sibmah: your branches passed over the sea, they reached even to the sea of Jazer: on your summer fruits and on your vintage the destroyer is fallen.

title: Jeremiah 48:33
text: Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to cease from the wine presses: none shall tread with shouting; the shouting shall be no shouting.

title: Jeremiah 48:34
text: From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim, to Eglath Shelishiyah: for the waters of Nimrim also shall become desolate.

title: Jeremiah 48:35
text: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, says Yahweh, him who offers in the high place, and him who burns incense to his gods.

title: Jeremiah 48:36
text: Therefore my heart sounds for Moab like pipes, and my heart sounds like pipes for the men of Kir Heres: therefore the abundance that he has gotten is perished.

title: Jeremiah 48:37
text: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped: on all the hands are cuttings, and on the waist sackcloth.

title: Jeremiah 48:38
text: On all the housetops of Moab and in its streets there is lamentation every where; for I have broken Moab like a vessel in which none delights, says Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 48:39
text: How is it broken down! [how] do they wail! how has Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab become a derision and a terror to all who are around him.

title: Jeremiah 48:40
text: For thus says Yahweh: Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread out his wings against Moab.

title: Jeremiah 48:41
text: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized, and the heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

title: Jeremiah 48:42
text: Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 48:43
text: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are on you, inhabitant of Moab, says Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 48:44
text: He who flees from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he who gets up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation, says Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 48:45
text: Those who fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire is gone forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and has devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

title: Jeremiah 48:46
text: Woe to you, O Moab! the people of Chemosh is undone; for your sons are taken away captive, and your daughters into captivity.

title: Jeremiah 48:47
text: Yet will I bring back the captivity of Moab in the latter days, says Yahweh. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.

title: Jeremiah 49:1
text: Of the children of Ammon. Thus says Yahweh: Has Israel no sons? has he no heir? why then does Malcam possess Gad, and his people well in its cities?

title: Jeremiah 49:2
text: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard against Rabbah of the children of Ammon; and it shall become a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel possess those who did possess him, says Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 49:3
text: Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste; cry, you daughters of Rabbah, clothe yourself in sackcloth: lament, and run back and forth among the fences; for Malcam shall go into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

title: Jeremiah 49:4
text: Why do you glory in the valleys, your flowing valley, backsliding daughter? who trusted in her treasures, [saying], Who shall come to me?

title: Jeremiah 49:5
text: Behold, I will bring a fear on you, says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, from all who are around you; and you shall be driven out every man right forth, and there shall be none to gather together the fugitives.

title: Jeremiah 49:6
text: But afterward I will bring back the captivity of the children of Ammon, says Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 49:7
text: Of Edom. Thus says Yahweh of Armies: Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?

title: Jeremiah 49:8
text: Flee, turn back, dwell in the depths, inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau on him, the time that I shall visit him.

title: Jeremiah 49:9
text: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, wouldn't they destroy until they had enough?

title: Jeremiah 49:10
text: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is destroyed, and his brothers, and his neighbors; and he is no more.

title: Jeremiah 49:11
text: Leave your fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let your widows trust in me.

title: Jeremiah 49:12
text: For thus says Yahweh: Behold, they to whom it didn't pertain to drink of the cup shall certainly drink; and are you he who shall altogether go unpunished? You shall not go unpunished, but you shall surely drink.

title: Jeremiah 49:13
text: For I have sworn by myself, says Yahweh, that Bozrah shall become an astonishment, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all its cities shall be perpetual wastes.

title: Jeremiah 49:14
text: I have heard news from Yahweh, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, [saying], Gather yourselves together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.

title: Jeremiah 49:15
text: For, behold, I have made you small among the nations, and despised among men.

title: Jeremiah 49:16
text: As for your terror, the pride of your heart has deceived you, O you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, who hold the height of the hill: though you should make your nest as high as the eagle, I will bring you down from there, says Yahweh.

title: Jeremiah 49:17
text: Edom shall become an astonishment: everyone who passes by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all its plagues.

title: Jeremiah 49:18
text: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbor cities of it, says Yahweh, no man shall dwell there, neither shall any son of man live therein.

title: Jeremiah 49:19
text: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation: for I will suddenly make them run away from it; and whoever is chosen, him will I appoint over it: for who is like me? and who will appoint me a time? and who is the shepherd who will stand before me?

title: Jeremiah 49:20
text: Therefore hear the counsel of Yahweh, that he has taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he has purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely they shall drag them away, [even] the little ones of the flock; surely he shall make their habitation desolate over them.

title: Jeremiah 49:21
text: The earth trembles at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise which is heard in the Red Sea.

title: Jeremiah 49:22
text: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah: and the heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

title: Jeremiah 49:23
text: Of Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad; for they have heard evil news, they are melted away: there is sorrow on the sea; it can't be quiet.

title: Jeremiah 49:24
text: Damascus has grown feeble, she turns herself to flee, and trembling has seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in travail.

title: Jeremiah 49:25
text: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the city of my joy?

title: Jeremiah 49:26
text: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be brought to silence in that day, says Yahweh of Armies.

title: Jeremiah 49:27
